About the role: 

 

As Account Director, working within our client, & global FMCG business; you are the trusted day-to-day partner for client and the person who keeps complex, multi-platform projects on track. You'll work closely with strategy, creative, production and account colleagues to turn briefs into effective campaigns, with a strong focus on social media and digital content. You'll be accountable for delivery, client satisfaction and project profitability across several projects at once.

What you will be doing: 

  • Build a collaborative, trusted relationship with client stakeholders, acting as their first point of contact and protecting the brand across every project.

  • Be responsible for the financial health of your projects, including profitability, forecasting accuracy and fee discussions. Make sure everyone understands the cost impact of delays, extra amends and re-briefs.

  • Evaluate project results, both qualitative and quantitative, against the original objectives.
  • Guide internal stakeholders through production processes, and spot and act on ad hoc opportunities as they arise.

 

What you need to be great in this role: 

  • Experience managing digital and integrated campaigns in a creative or production agency, with a strong record of delivering across multiple platforms, particularly social media.
  • Ideally FMCG experience
  • Proficient to expert capability in Account Management and Project Management, with confidence running several complex projects at once.

  • Nice to have: experience creating content for CMS and e-commerce platforms.
  • Advanced use of Gen AI tools relevant to account management to improve output quality and efficiency
  • Experience designing AI-assisted workflows for yourself and your team
  • Agentic thinking for complex, multi-step challenges

Who We Are

As an Account Executive focused on Strategic Deals, you'll join a founding GTM movement inside an established market leader trusted by over 4,500 global customers, unlocking high-impact opportunities through top-tier strategic partnerships.

DoiT empowers cloud-native organizations to scale faster and innovate with confidence. By combining our Cloud Intelligence technology with Forward Deployed Engineers and deep specialization across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure, we help tech-forward companies navigate their toughest infrastructure and cost governance challenges end to end.

The Opportunity
As an Account Executive, Strategic Deals for Attribute™, you will be at the forefront of building a brand-new region from scratch and introducing a groundbreaking solution to a fundamental business problem in modern FinOps. You will work on Strategic Deals, leveraging strategic partnerships with AWS, OpenAI, Top Private Equity firms, and our global current install base. A strong focus will be placed on co-selling and unlocking strategic deal opportunities with AWS, ISVs, and channel partners. Traditional cloud cost allocation methods rely heavily on static tagging—an approach that becomes obsolete in modern, shared cloud and AI infrastructure. When multi-tenant clusters, shared GPUs, microservices, and dynamic AI workloads dominate, organizations face severe blind spots: they cannot accurately determine the true cost-to-serve for specific applications, autonomous agents, or business teams, making it impossible to calculate true gross margins at a granular customer level.

Attribute™ solves this by taking a completely different approach. Leveraging runtime eBPF technology, Attribute™ captures real-time network traffic signals and kernel-level observability without requiring engineering teams to manually tag or instrument code. By analyzing actual runtime consumption across CPU, GPU, memory, network, and AI model API requests, it provides accurate total cost of ownership (TCO) and unit economics based on real usage. Organizations finally get precise cost governance and gross margin visibility across complex cloud and AI environments with zero developer overhead.

As an Account Executive building this region from scratch, you will establish a high-potential greenfield territory. description:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provides clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns. 

Position Overview

CRA’s Life Sciences practice helps pharmaceutical, biotechnology, diagnostics and medical device companies achieve optimum performance across key aspects of their business, including innovation, commercial success, organization, and reputation, all for the long-term benefit of patients, clinicians, employees, and shareholders. We work with life sciences businesses directly as well as with their legal counsel, industry associations, government organizations, and advocacy groups from the earliest stages of research into new therapy areas, through product development, to the delivery of products that will achieve commercial success and fulfill the expectations of our clients and their key stakeholders.

Senior Associates at CRA work on project teams with senior and junior consultants on a variety of client engagements across industries. Senior Associates conduct advanced strategic analysis and assist in the management of consulting projects. They serve as a project manager, direct the work of others, oversee analysis, manage mid-level client relationships, and/or communicate project results. Staff at this level are expected to work independently with minimal supervision.

To be successful in this role, you must be able to effectively plan and manage the execution of smaller projects or significant sub-tasks on larger, more complex projects, conceptualize and analyse issues, and perform or direct a wide variety of analytical tasks. We also highly value a strong work ethic, creativity, a positive attitude, and a high level of energy. At this time, we are specifically seeking consultants with strong knowledge of pricing and access systems in Europe and globally. Typical Senior Associate responsibilities include:

  • Independently identify/design analytic tasks and contribute to the development of overall analytic framework for consulting projects;
  • Interface with client representatives to communicate developments and present results;
  • Draft reports or presentations, or sections of reports or presentations;
  • Contribute to project planning and budget management efforts;
  • Provide training and technical supervision to less-experienced staff, including reviewing their analyses and providing coaching/direction;
  • Contribute to business development efforts and draft client proposals.

Desired Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in life sciences (e.g., biology, biotechnology, biochemistry, pharmacology, chemistry etc.) or a relevant analytical degree, with significant work experience;
  • 3-6 years previous consulting experience;
  • Strong skills in quantitative and qualitative analysis methods and techniques;
  • Proven staff and project management skills;
  • Client interaction, facilitation, presentation, budgeting, and project planning skills;
  • Strong knowledge of pricing and market access issues in the European markets (and globally);
  • Occasional travel required.

To Apply

To be considered for this position, we require the following:

  • Resume – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;
  • Cover letter – please describe your interest in CRA and how this role matches your goals.

Career Growth and Benefits 

  • CRA’s robust skills development programs, including a commitment to offering training annually through formal and informal programs, encouraging you to thrive as an individual and team member. Beginning with skill building, training continues with technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.
  • We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.  

Our Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer (Equality Act 2010). All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

 

____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

 

Über Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates ist eine führende globale Beratungsfirma, die wirtschaftliche, finanzielle und betriebswirtschaftliche Expertise für große Anwaltskanzleien, Unternehmen und Regierungen weltweit bietet. CRA berät Kunden in wirtschaftlichen und finanziellen Angelegenheiten im Zusammenhang mit Rechtsstreitigkeiten und behördlichen Verfahren und unterstützt Unternehmen bei kritischen Geschäftsstrategien und leistungsbezogenen Fragen. Seit 1965 engagieren Kunden CRA aufgrund der Kombination aus Branchenerfahrung und rigoroser, faktenbasierter Analyse, die klare, umsetzbare Lösungen für komplexe Geschäftsprobleme bietet.

Stellenübersicht

Die Life Sciences Practice von CRA hilft Pharma-, Biotechnologie-, Medtech- und Digital-Health-Unternehmen, optimale Leistungen in wichtigen Geschäftsbereichen wie kommerzielle Strategie, Preisgestaltung und Zugang, Innovation, Organisationsstruktur, Politikanalyse, medizinische Angelegenheiten, Stakeholder-Management und Marketing zu erzielen – alles zum langfristigen Nutzen von Patienten, Ärzten, Mitarbeitern und Aktionären. Wir arbeiten direkt mit Life-Sciences-Unternehmen sowie mit deren Rechtsberatern, Industrieverbänden, Regierungsorganisationen und Interessengruppen zusammen.

Associate Principals bei CRA arbeiten gemeinsam mit erfahrenen und jüngeren Consultants in Projektteams an einer Vielzahl von Kundenprojekten in unterschiedlichen Branchen. Sie führen anspruchsvolle strategische Analysen durch und unterstützen bei der Steuerung von Beratungsprojekten. Dabei übernehmen sie die Projektleitung, koordinieren die Arbeit anderer Teammitglieder, verantworten Analysen, betreuen Kundenbeziehungen auf mittlerer Ebene und/oder kommunizieren Projektergebnisse. In dieser Position arbeiten Sie weitgehend selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich.

Für eine erfolgreiche Tätigkeit in dieser Position sollten Sie in der Lage sein, kleinere Projekte oder wesentliche Teilaufgaben größerer und komplexerer Projekte effektiv zu planen und zu steuern, Fragestellungen zu strukturieren und zu analysieren sowie ein breites Spektrum analytischer Aufgaben selbst durchzuführen oder anzuleiten. Darüber hinaus legen wir großen Wert auf eine ausgeprägte Arbeitsethik, Kreativität, eine positive Einstellung und ein hohes Maß an Engagement.

Aktuell suchen wir insbesondere Consultants mit fundierten Kenntnissen der Pricing- und Market-Access-Systeme in Europa und weltweit.

Aufgaben

  • Sie identifizieren und konzipieren eigenständig die erforderlichen Analysen und wirken an der Entwicklung des übergreifenden analytischen Ansatzes für Beratungsprojekte mit.
  • Sie stehen im direkten Austausch mit unseren Kunden, informieren sie über den Projektfortschritt und präsentieren Ergebnisse.
  • Sie erstellen Berichte und Präsentationen oder übernehmen die Ausarbeitung einzelner Abschnitte.
  • Sie wirken bei der Projektplanung und der Steuerung von Projektbudgets mit.
  • Sie unterstützen weniger erfahrene Teammitglieder bei ihrer fachlichen Weiterentwicklung, prüfen deren Analysen und geben ihnen fachliche Anleitung und Feedback.
  • Sie bringen sich in die Geschäftsentwicklung ein und wirken bei der Erstellung von Angeboten für Kunden mit.

Gewünschte Qualifikationen

  • Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss im Bereich Life Sciences, z. B. in Biologie, Biotechnologie, Biochemie, Pharmakologie oder Chemie, oder in einem relevanten Studiengang mit analytischem Schwerpunkt sowie einschlägige Berufserfahrung;
  • 5 bis 7 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Beratung;
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse und Erfahrung in der Anwendung quantitativer und qualitativer Analysemethoden;
  • Nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Mitarbeiterführung und im Projektmanagement;
  • Erfahrung im direkten Kundenkontakt, in der Moderation und Präsentation sowie in der Budget- und Projektplanung;
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse zu Pricing und Market Access in europäischen und internationalen Märkten;
  • Deutschkenntnisse von Vorteil;
  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen.

Bewerbung

Um für diese Position berücksichtigt zu werden, reichen Sie bitte die folgenden Unterlagen ein:

  • Lebenslauf – bitte geben Sie Ihre aktuelle Adresse, eprsönliche E-Mail-Adresse und Telefonnummer an;
  • Anschreiben – Bitte beschreiben Sie Ihr Interesse an CRA und wie diese Rolle zu Ihren Zielen passt.

Karriereentwicklung und Benefits

  • CRA bietet Ihnen vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung. Dazu gehören jährliche formelle und informelle Weiterbildungsangebote, die Ihre individuelle Entwicklung ebenso fördern wie Ihre Zusammenarbeit im Team. Das Angebot reicht von Trainings zur Weiterentwicklung Ihrer fachlichen und persönlichen Kompetenzen über Präsentationstrainings und interne Seminare bis hin zu individuellem Karriere-Mentoring und Performance-Coaching durch eine erfahrene Kollegin oder einen erfahrenen Kollegen. Darüber hinaus bieten interne Initiativen die Möglichkeit, zusätzliche Führungsverantwortung zu übernehmen und sich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung von CRA einzubringen.
  • Wir bieten Ihnen ein umfassendes Vergütungs- und Leistungspaket mit attraktiven Zusatzleistungen. Dazu gehören Angebote zur Förderung Ihres körperlichen, mentalen, emotionalen und finanziellen Wohlbefindens sowie interne Unterstützung bei Einwanderungs- und Visaangelegenheiten für internationale Mitarbeitende und Geschäftsreisende.

Flexibilität am Arbeitsplatz

CRA schafft ein Arbeitsumfeld, das es unseren Kollegen ermöglicht, von der Zusammenarbeit im Büro zu profitieren, um unser Versprechen von beruflichem Wachstum, Mentoring und Inklusivität bestmöglich zu erfüllen. Gleichzeitig erkennen wir an, dass Einzelpersonen eine Reihe von Vorteilen genießen, wenn sie periodisch von zu Hause aus arbeiten. Derzeit bitten wir Mitarbeiter, im Durchschnitt 3 bis 4 Tage die Woche im Büro zu arbeiten (was Reisen zu einem anderen CRA-Büro oder zum Standort eines Kunden einschließen kann). Zu bestimmten Zeiten des Jahres (z.B. Feiertagsperioden) werden zusätzliche Remote-Arbeitsoptionen für diejenigen angeboten, deren Arbeitsverpflichtungen dies zulassen, obwohl unsere Büros für diejenigen, die dort sein möchten oder müssen, geöffnet bleiben.

Unser Engagement für Vielfalt

Charles River Associates ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit bietet. Im Rahmen unseres Fokus auf Gerechtigkeit und Inklusion arbeiten wir daran, einen fairen und konsistenten Einstellungsprozess sicherzustellen. Wir feiern Vielfalt und sind für ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld engagiert.

description: PROJECT OVERVIEW We are looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to develop innovative deeplearning models that predict the structure of functional-oxide thin films directly from their growth dynamics. Positioned at the interface between Artificial Intelligence and materials physics, the OXYD-IA project aims to design a deep model able to predict the final X-ray Diffraction (XRD) spectrum of an oxide thin film from the sole Reflection High-Energy Electron Diffraction (RHEED) video recorded during its growth by Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE). The resulting tool will open the way to predictive, in situ control of oxide epitaxy – a process today dominated by a costly trial-and-error approach, in which the structural and functional properties of the films are only validated ex situ. You will join a genuinely multidisciplinary collaboration between the INL (Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon), which provides the operando experimental data and materials-physics expertise, and the LIRIS (équipe Imagine), which provides the deep video-learning and probabilistic-modelling methodology – both at École Centrale de Lyon. A high-impact opportunity. AI for experimental physics is a fast-growing field, and OXYD-IA offers a genuine first-mover advantage within it: you would work on a unique, unpublished dataset of paired RHEED videos and XRD spectra to build one of the first video-to-spectrum models with calibrated uncertainty for oxide growth. By learning directly from experimental 1 data, such a model can short-circuit the traditional trial-and-error loop, accelerate discovery and drastically cut experimental time, cost, precursor consumption and instrument occupancy – turning routine in situ diagnostics into predictive tools. Scientific context. Epitaxial perovskite-oxide thin films exhibit rich, tunable functional properties (thermoelectricity, ferroelectricity, piezoelectricity) governed by their structure and composition, themselves correlated with the growth conditions. MBE offers independent control of each element but, applied to oxides, is notoriously unstable and poorly reproducible because of the oxidising atmosphere. RHEED tracks the surface dynamics in real time (lattice parameter, surface reconstructions, roughness) but does not give access to the final bulk microstructure, which is only reachable ex situ via XRD / XRR. There is therefore a strong physical link – so far unexploited quantitatively – between RHEED dynamics and final XRD microstructure, which OXYD-IA proposes to learn directly. Figure 1 – OXYD-IA pipeline. At inference, the RHEED video acquired during growth (INL) feeds a deep video encoder (LIRIS) and a probabilistic regression module that predicts the final XRD spectrum together with its uncertainty. During training, the predicted spectrum is compared with the ex situ XRD / XRR spectrum measured at INL (ground truth); this discrepancy is the supervised learning signal that adjusts the model parameters. KEY RESEARCH AREAS AND RESPONSIBILITIES You will drive the core computational research along a risk-managed, phased 12-month roadmap. The primary target is a versioned RHEED / XRD dataset, growth-regime classification and probabilistic regression of the key structural parameters with calibrated uncertainty; full-spectrum prediction, a real-time demonstrator and cross-oxide generalisation are stretch and follow-on objectives. The work is organised around three technical pillars: 1. Corpus structuring and spatio-temporal RHEED representation • Build a versioned dataset by cleaning, temporally aligning and pairing the RHEED video sequences, the associated MBE parameters (temperature, oxygen pressure, source fluxes) and the ex situ XRD / XRR spectra (SrTiO3 reference system). • Pre-train, in a self-supervised manner, a spatio-temporal video encoder (3D CNN, e.g. R(2+1)D, or temporal Vision Transformer) fine-tuned on the laboratory corpus. • Perform fuzzy / Bayesian classification of the growth regimes (2D vs. 3D modes, transitions, RHEED oscillations), building on LIRIS expertise in the statistical analysis of sequences. 2. Probabilistic RHEED →XRD regression with uncertainty quantification • Design a latent representation that couples the video encoding with the physical MBE parameters. • Learn stepwise – first scalar structural parameters (lattice parameter, density, mosaicity), more robust at small N, then the full 1D XRD spectrum. • Provide calibrated uncertainty estimates (Bayesian approaches or deep ensembles), indispensable for guiding real-time decisions during growth. 3. Real-time demonstrator and dissemination (stretch / follow-on) • Validate the model on new SrTiO3 growths and prototype an in-growth inference tool at the end of the NANOFUTUR MBE line. • Mitigate the small-data and generalisation challenges through temporal data augmentation, transfer learning from pre-trained video encoders and domain adaptation towards other functional oxides. • Contribute toward a high-impact joint publication at the AI / materials interface (the project milestone is the submission of a joint paper). REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS • A Ph.D. in the field of Artificial Intelligence – Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision or Signal Processing, and we are looking for a senior postdoc with 2–5 years of post-PhD experience. • Deep learning on sequential / video data: demonstrable, hands-on experience with 3D CNNs, temporal transformers and / or probabilistic models. Proficiency in Python and PyTorch (or TensorFlow) is mandatory. • A genuine appetite for physics: a strong curiosity for, or prior exposure to, experimental physics and materials science. The ideal candidate carried out an AI-focused Ph.D. and is eager to apply it to a real materials-physics problem. • Research mindset: a track record of innovation and the ability to work autonomously on a complex, multidisciplinary project. • Software skills: experience with Git version control and reproducible research. • Excellent communication and scientific-writing skills in English. ADDITIONAL SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES • Self-supervised video pre-training, uncertainty quantification (Bayesian / ensembles), fuzzy classification, or domain adaptation. • Experience with small-sample / transfer-learning settings and handling large-scale experimental datasets. HOW TO APPLY Please prepare a single PDF file containing: 1. A detailed Curriculum Vitae, including a list of publications. 2. A 1-page motivation letter explaining your specific interest in this project and how your background addresses the key responsibilities and qualifications listed above. 3. The names and contact information of at least two academic references. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: L’investissement à impact est un secteur d’activité en forte croissance. INCO Ventures, acteur clé de ce domaine en France, gère et conseille six fonds d’investissement dédiés au financement des entreprises à fort impact social et/ou environnemental. Il investit principalement dans des cibles en changement d’échelle et/ou en développement (tickets d’investissement compris entre 300k€ et 2M€). Pourquoi nous recrutons Nous sommes une société de gestion spécialisée dans l’investissement à impact. Nous accompagnons des entreprises qui contribuent aux grandes transitions environnementales et sociales, tout en recherchant une performance financière attractive pour nos investisseurs. Au fil des années, nous avons construit nos outils et nos processus autour d’Airtable, de différentes solutions SaaS et d’usages ponctuels de l’intelligence artificielle. Cette organisation nous a permis de grandir rapidement. Aujourd’hui, nous souhaitons franchir une nouvelle étape. Notre ambition est de construire une véritable plateforme data et IA au service de l’ensemble de notre écosystème : L’équipe de gestion Les équipes middle office et conformité Nos investisseurs (LPs) Les entreprises de notre portefeuille Concrètement, nous souhaitons faire évoluer notre architecture de données, automatiser davantage nos processus, déployer des usages IA à forte valeur ajoutée et créer des espaces digitaux permettant à chacun d’accéder simplement aux informations dont il ou elle a besoin. Pour nous accompagner dans cette transformation, nous recrutons un.e stagiaire qui travaillera directement avec le Responsable Conformité & Middle Office ainsi qu’un.e Directeur.rice d’investissement. Ce stage est autant un projet de construction qu’un projet d’innovation : nous recherchons une personne capable de comprendre les enjeux métier, de proposer des solutions et de contribuer à leur mise en œuvre. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement très transversal, avec une forte autonomie et la possibilité de contribuer aussi bien à la réflexion qu'à l'implémentation des solutions. Les missions décrites ci-dessous constituent une feuille de route initiale. Elles évolueront naturellement en fonction de l’avancement du projet, de vos centres d’intérêt et des opportunités identifiées ensemble. Comprendre et structurer notre écosystème de données Vous participerez notamment à : Cartographier les bases Airtable existantes et leurs usages Comprendre les flux de données entre les différentes équipes Identifier les redondances, points de friction et opportunités d’amélioration Participer à la conception du modèle de données cible Contribuer, le cas échéant, à la migration progressive vers Supabase Structurer les données financières, impact et ESG Définir les règles d’accès et de gouvernance des données Documenter les modèles, processus et bonnes pratiques L’objectif est de construire un socle de données fiable, partagé et durable. 2. Automatiser les processus clés Une fois les données structurées, vous contribuerez à automatiser les tâches répétitives et à fluidifier les opérations. Exemples : Collecte de données auprès des participations, relances automatiques Consolidation de reportings Contrôles de cohérence Gestion documentaire Préparation de certains livrables réglementaires Qualification et enrichissement automatique d'opportunités d'investissement Circulation de l’information entre les outils Vous participerez à la conception et au déploiement de workflows no-code et low-code, principalement via N8N et les APIs des différents outils utilisés par la société. 3. Déployer des usages IA concrets Nous cherchons quelqu’un qui saura identifier où l’IA peut réellement créer de la valeur. Cela pourra inclure : Portail équipe de gestion Suivi des participations Reporting portefeuille Outils internes de pilotage Portail investisseurs (LPs) Consultation des reportings Suivi des indicateurs de portefeuille Diffusion sécurisée des informations réglementaires Portail participations Collecte de données Suivi des indicateurs financiers et extra-financiers Partage documentaire 5. description: In a world where geopolitical tensions and security threats are accelerating, the way nations protect people and preserve peace is being redefined. For a long time, innovating in defense was about making tougher hardware. But with the evolution of software and the recent AI disruption, the future of defense is shifting to software-powered unmanned systems that save lives by removing humans from the front line. This is our mission. At Intelic, we're building the intelligence layer for unmanned systems in defense. As a software-first company, we enable autonomous platforms to operate together - faster, smarter, and more reliably - across complex, mission-critical environments. Our technology turns disconnected assets into coordinated forces, helping operators make accurate decisions when it matters most. Based in Amsterdam and growing fast, Intelic offers a rare opportunity to work on products that don't just move metrics - they meaningfully impact safety, resilience, and the future of Europe's security. Why This Role Exists Nexus has to run in places most software never goes: offline, in the field, installed and operated by people who are not developers. Getting it there in one piece, and keeping it running, is a job on its own. Right now that job sits mostly with three backend engineers who cover this alongside their own work. As Nexus grows, so does the team, and we're adding someone to take real ownership of the pipelines, installers, and infrastructure that turn Nexus into something operators can trust, and who treats security as part of how the work gets done, not a separate project bolted on afterwards. There is there is plenty of custom tooling to build. A level head under pressure. You can prioritise and stay steady when a few things break at once Nice to have: Experience with on-prem, bare-metal or virtulized infrastructure, not just cloud consoles Familiarity with Docker Exposure to dependency and package scanning tools such as Sonatype An interest in platform or infrastructure engineering as its own discipline. description: For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands. About SkinVision Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped nearly 3 million people worldwide detect early signs of skin cancer. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin spot assessments and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. High-risk cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need. DevOps at SkinVision As a DevOps Engineer at SkinVision, you will play a key role in building, scaling, and securing the infrastructure that powers our AI-driven health platform. You’ll design and maintain our cloud-based systems in AWS, implement CI/CD pipelines, enhance observability using Datadog, and drive operational excellence through automation and monitoring. Your work will directly impact the reliability and scalability of a medical-grade system that serves users globally. You’ll collaborate closely with backend, ML, and product teams to ensure smooth delivery, rapid deployments, and resilient operations — ultimately enabling us to deliver life-saving technology with confidence. Beyond hands-on expertise with AWS and modern DevOps tooling, we’re looking for someone who thinks architecturally. You’ll get to know our current setup, form your own view of how it should evolve, and help define a target vision for our infrastructure, then drive its implementation. Day-to-day operational work is part of the role, but we value someone who thinks before building and takes ownership of where our infrastructure goes next. What you will do Cloud Infrastructure & Automation Design, build, and manage AWS-based infrastructure, ensuring high availability, scalability, and cost efficiency. Implement and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation. Automate environment provisioning, configuration, and deployments using CI/CD pipelines. Ensure system resilience, security, and performance through automated monitoring and alerting. CI/CD & Deployment Design and optimize CI/CD pipelines to support rapid, reliable, and safe deployments across environments. Manage deployment workflows using Argo CD and Kubernetes. Collaborate with developers and ML engineers to streamline build, test, and release processes. Integrate automated testing, rollback strategies, and version control into the deployment lifecycle. Observability & Monitoring Build a comprehensive observability stack using Datadog for metrics, logs, traces, and alerts. Define service-level objectives (SLOs), service-level indicators (SLIs), and dashboards for system performance. Proactively detect and resolve performance bottlenecks, capacity issues, and reliability risks. Create automated health checks and ensure visibility across production systems. Security & Compliance Implement security best practices for AWS, containers, and CI/CD pipelines. Manage identity, access, and secret handling (IAM, Secrets Manager, Parameter Store). Ensure compliance with medical device standards and data privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA). Partner with the Information Security Officer to embed security controls across infrastructure and deployments. Reliability & Incident Management Lead incident response and root cause analysis for infrastructure or deployment-related issues. Establish SLAs and operational runbooks for production environments. Continuously improve system reliability through chaos testing, redundancy, and fault tolerance. Mentor engineers on DevOps principles, observability practices, and infrastructure automation. Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture Assess the current infrastructure and deployment setup, and form a well-reasoned view of how it should evolve. Define and maintain a target architecture for our cloud platform, balancing reliability, scalability, security, and cost. Translate the target vision into a practical roadmap and drive its implementation incrementally, alongside day-to-day operations. Document and communicate architectural decisions, aligning with engineering and leadership on technical direction. Essential skills Minimum of 6 years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Cloud Infrastructure roles. Strong expertise with AWS services (EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, Lambda, etc.). Expert in Kubernetes and Argo CD, deploying and managing production-grade custom Helm charts with secure, automated GitOps workflows in EKS Advanced knowledge of CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar). Proficiency in Datadog for observability, monitoring, and alerting. Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, or Go. Experience managing infrastructure with Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible. Familiarity with networking fundamentals, load balancing, and API gateway configuration. Excellent problem-solving and incident management skills. Desirable skills Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, MedTech, or FinTech. Familiarity with multi-environment architecture (staging, pre-prod, production) and blue-green deployments. Exposure to event-driven systems, message queues, and data streaming (Kafka, SNS/SQS). Understanding of Zero Trust networking and cloud security best practices. Experience in cost optimization and performance tuning in AWS. Qualifications A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), or Terraform Associate are a plus. description: About Agent F Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention. Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control. We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. These founding roles will shape both the product and the way we build it. About the role You will be a full-stack engineer, shipping customer features across the interface, application services and database. Your particular strength will be the data and infrastructure that make those features dependable: how records are stored, how imports and background jobs run, and how information moves between Agent F and a customer’s other tools. You will help build and operate the whole product, with deeper ownership of this foundation. This is hands-on full-stack engineering. A typical piece of work could involve extending a data model, implementing an application service, connecting it to a screen, testing it against a real database and following the release into production. You will also investigate slow reports, failed imports and jobs that stop halfway through, then improve the system so it handles those situations reliably. That foundation also supports our AI work. As we add document extraction, connected customer knowledge and software that takes actions for customers, you will build the services and data access those features need. The immediate priority is dependable software that customers can use, with more capable automation developed around specific tasks. What you will build and improve Application services and customer features. Build the logic and application programming interfaces (APIs) that connect records, business rules and screens. Take features through implementation, testing, release and production support. The database foundation. Design clear data models, enforce relationships and transaction boundaries, and improve slow queries. Manage schema changes through reviewed migrations, preserve financial history and keep each customer’s data isolated. Imports and integrations. Connect accounting tools, business systems and spreadsheets to a consistent model. Validate incoming records, handle changing source formats, and check that imported totals and reports agree with the source. Reliable background processing. Build scheduled jobs and workers that process work outside a user request. Handle retries without creating duplicates, resume interrupted runs, and make progress and failures visible to the team. Performance and recovery. Diagnose expensive queries, processing bottlenecks and partial failures. Test changes against real databases, plan for growing workloads, and build procedures to recover processing safely with the platform engineer. Practical AI automation. Add features such as extracting invoice fields or preparing an order from approved business data. Give models access through controlled services, check the result and require approval where needed. Develop connected customer knowledge when a feature needs those relationships, and measure whether it improves the result. For example, a large customer import stops halfway through and the same records arrive again on the next run. You would make processing resume safely, prevent duplicate records, verify the resulting totals and expose the job’s status in the product. You would also investigate whether database queries or worker capacity caused the failure and ship the necessary fix. What you bring You have seven or more years of software engineering experience, including substantial ownership of production applications and data systems. You have designed relational data models, built services and processing pipelines, and stayed responsible for them after release. You are comfortable delivering across the stack and using AI tools in your daily work. You can explain how you diagnosed a slow query, recovered a failed job or shipped a database change safely. You understand what happens when two requests arrive at once, a dependency becomes unavailable or a process restarts halfway through its work. You can follow a problem from a source record through the application to the result a customer sees. Core experience Full-stack development with TypeScript, Node.js, React and PostgreSQL, or closely comparable technologies. Relational data modelling, SQL, query optimisation, indexes, transactions and reviewed database migrations. Application services and APIs, including permissions, validation and handling concurrent requests. Data imports, integrations and background jobs, including queues, safe retries and recovery from partial failures. Production debugging, service monitoring and performance work on systems used by real customers. Automated tests against real databases and other service dependencies. Practical use of AI in software, with an understanding of how to check outputs and control access to customer data. Daily use of AI coding agents, with direct responsibility for code review and verification. A computer science or computer engineering degree, or equivalent practical depth. Useful additional experience Financial or operational systems where correctness and traceability matter; larger data migrations; cloud storage and container-based workloads. Experience putting document extraction or features using large language models (LLMs) into production would be valuable. Knowledge graphs, which connect related company records, and privately hosted or adapted models are useful as we develop that part of the product. What early progress could look like In your first months, you would take ownership of an existing service or data flow, understand how it runs in production and ship a customer-facing improvement through it. You would address a concrete reliability or performance problem, such as a slow report, a fragile integration or a job that cannot recover cleanly after interruption. We would look for working features, faster and more predictable processing, fewer failed or manually repaired jobs, and useful tests and monitoring. An early automation feature could follow where the data and services are ready and its benefit can be measured. Operational excellence and customer commitments You take pride in a dependable application backbone: processing completes, records reconcile and customers can trust the results. When a job fails or figures disagree, you take ownership of the investigation and recovery. Missing transactions, duplicate entries or unexplained balance differences can be financial emergencies even while every service appears available. You assess the impact, contain affected processing, trace the cause and verify the repaired result before treating the incident as resolved. Customer commitments shape how we work. You are willing to interrupt planned work, respond promptly and stay engaged when an urgent issue puts a service-level agreement (SLA), onboarding commitment or financial deadline at risk. That requires flexibility beyond normal working hours as part of agreed on-call coverage and coordinated incident response. You keep people informed and see the issue through to a verified recovery or an explicit handover. Afterwards, you improve the system so the same emergency becomes less likely. How you will work This is a senior founding role in a small team. You will own the application and data infrastructure for your work, and carry a full share of customer feature delivery. You will collaborate across infrastructure, operations and product design to deliver complete customer outcomes. You will use coding agents to implement changes and remain responsible for reviewing, testing and operating the result. Everyone shares responsibility for the whole product and the customer outcome. You will pick up the most important work or whatever is on fire, including tasks outside your specialty. You take initiative, bring in the right expertise and stay involved until the problem is resolved. Customer impact and urgency determine where you focus. description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

As the Head of Talent Acquisition, EMEA, you own the build-out of Anduril's talent acquisition capability across
the EMEA region. Reporting to the Senior Director of Talent Acquisition and partnering closely with the Head of
Strategic Planning for Talent Acquisition, you are a key member of the TA Leadership team with a specific
mandate: geo-specific scaling. You own the in-country, site-specific, and division-specific hiring build-out across
EMEA, working in close partnership with the Head of Talent Acquisition, APAC and with each Divisional Head of
TA who is adding headcount into your region.

This is not a divisional leadership seat. You are not embedded in any single business unit's leadership team; you
are the connective tissue across all of them for one geography. Multiple divisions will be scaling into EMEA at
once, often into the same countries and talent pools, and your job is to make sure their combined demand lands
on a coherent, compliant, and well-resourced regional hiring capability, rather than five uncoordinated efforts
competing for the same candidates.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Regional Strategy and Build-Out
• Define and execute Anduril's EMEA talent acquisition strategy, directly informed by the combined hiring
demand of every division scaling into the region.
• Own EMEA hiring outcomes (time-to-fill, quality, acceptance rates) as the single accountable owner for
regional delivery.
• Own EMEA hiring governance, compliance, and workforce planning across the region's countries, each with
distinct labor law, works council, and candidate market dynamics.
• Develop EMEA hiring playbooks, and partner with the Head of Talent Acquisition, APAC to share what's
working across both regions rather than each building in isolation.
• Partner with the Head of Strategic Planning for Talent Acquisition to evaluate where EMEA needs additional
in-country or sub-regional leadership as demand grows (e.g., a dedicated UK or Germany lead), and help
build the case and the structure for it.

Cross-Divisional Partnership and Prioritization
• Serve as the senior talent advisor to EMEA-based business leaders and to every Divisional Head of TA adding
headcount into the region, synthesizing what could otherwise be five disconnected divisional views into one
coherent regional talent picture.
• Partner with in-region recruiting resources and EMEA business leaders to ensure the regional model reflects
on-the-ground reality, not just headquarters assumptions.
• Act as the tie-breaker when multiple divisions' hiring demand converges on the same country, site, or talent
pool with more need than the region can serve at once, using an objective, business-impact-driven
framework.
• Drive continuous improvement through data and feedback loops, standardizing what should be consistent
across EMEA while preserving the flexibility each country and division genuinely needs.

Operational Cohesion with Peer Regions
• Partner closely with the Head of Strategic Planning for Talent Acquisition, a peer, not a manager, who is
accountable for cross-regional cohesion, shared playbooks, and consistency of operating rhythm across
EMEA and APAC.
• Loop in the Head of Strategic Planning early on build-out choices (tooling, process, governance) so that
EMEA and APAC remain coherent for divisions scaling into both regions.
• Resolve cross-regional alignment issues collaboratively, escalating to the Senior Director of Talent
Acquisition only when peer alignment can't be reached.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
• 10+ years of progressive TA experience, including demonstrated success building or scaling EMEA hiring
specifically, not just supporting it from a distance.
• Deep understanding of EMEA labor markets, employment law, works councils, and compliance
considerations across the region's key countries.
• Proven experience designing and executing an end-to-end regional talent acquisition strategy.
• Demonstrated ability to lead and influence across a matrixed structure, partnering with multiple Divisional
Heads of TA and business leaders who do not report to you.
• Strong track record of driving continuous improvement through data-driven decision making, with the ability
to report regional hiring outcomes credibly to Global TA Leadership.
• Exceptional communication and influencing skills, with the ability to reconcile competing divisional demand
for the same regional capacity and drive consensus without formal authority.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

perience partnering with or building out in-country resources as part of a broader regional build.

• Experience building a regional operating model that other regions (e.g., APAC) have adapted or could adapt.

• Prior experience as part of a broader transition from a U.S.-led to a localized, globally scalable TA model.

• Experience in defense, aerospace, or other hardware and software-intensive industries.

• A background in or strong familiarity with BizOps, program management, or business strategy.

Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:

    • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is ----- before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

    • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to 

 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

description:
Who/What is Artefact?
Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital, and analytics to help clients achieve tangible
business impact.
With 1,800+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 23 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. Our Zurich office is at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.

 

The role:
 
We are looking for a Manager who leads strategy and architecture projects focused on GenAI solutions. You will own the design of architectures and solutions end to end, balancing business value, technology choices and economics across every dimension of the decision.
You will lead development teams, present solutions to C-level stakeholders and run technical and strategic workshops independently.
 
Key responsibilities:
Project and programme leadership
  • Lead strategy and architecture projects on GenAI, from scoping and business case through to solution design and rollout oversight.
  • Own project plans, budgets, risks and quality, ensuring delivery against client objectives.
  • Shape proposals, estimates and demos, and identify follow-on opportunities with clients.
GenAI architecture and solution design
  • Design GenAI architectures and solutions: RAG, agentic systems, multi-agent orchestration, MCP and A2A integration, copilots and assistants.
  • Select and combine cloud-native AI services (e.g. Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Vertex AI, Bedrock, Databricks) with third-party and custom components.
  • Apply GenAI to support functions such as HR, Procurement, Legal, Finance and IT, redesigning processes and operating models around the new solutions.
Cross-dimension optimization and trade-offs
  • Orchestrate decisions across make, buy and customization options, weighing capex against opex and total cost of ownership.
  • Assess the impact of tool and architecture choices on vendor lock-in, performance, latency, scalability, security and compliance.
  • Translate these trade-offs into clear recommendations that business and IT leaders can act on.
Team and stakeholder leadership
  • Guide development teams technically: set the architecture, review solutions and unblock delivery.
  • Present solutions and recommendations to C-level audiences.
  • Run technical and strategic workshops independently, from discovery to design and prioritization.
  • Coach and develop consultants and architects in the team.
Requirements:
  • At least 8 years of professional experience in IT.
  • At least 3 years on AI/GenAI architecture and solution design projects.
  • Prior hands-on background as an engineer or developer.
  • Proven experience applying GenAI to support functions (HR, Procurement, Legal, Finance or IT).
  • Consulting experience, ideally in strategy consulting, combined with experience at a system integrator or delivery firm.
  • Track record of managing projects and leading teams, including development teams.
  • Experience presenting to C-level stakeholders and running workshops independently.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
Technical and functional skills:
  • GenAI architectures: RAG, agentic and multi-agent patterns, LLMOps, model evaluation, guardrails and responsible AI.
  • Agent protocols and copilots: MCP, A2A, Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio, custom assistants and their integration with enterprise systems.
  • Cloud AI platforms: Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI, Bedrock, Databricks and the native data and AI services of Azure, AWS and GCP.
  • Architecture trade-offs: make vs buy vs customize, capex vs opex, TCO, lock-in, performance, latency, scalability, security and compliance.
  • Support functions: processes and operating models in HR, Procurement, Legal, Finance and IT, and how GenAI changes them.
  • Delivery leadership: agile methods, technical team guidance, solution review, programme governance.
  • Business: business cases, value tracking, and the ability to translate technical choices into economic impact for executives.
Nice to have:
  • German not strictly required.
  • Cloud or AI certifications (e.g. Azure AI Engineer, Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Machine Learning).
What we offer:
  • A leadership role bridging strategy, architecture and GenAI delivery, with direct impact on client decisions.
  • International projects on GenAI, agentic systems and support function transformation.
  • A growth path towards senior programme and practice leadership roles.
  • Location and working model: (Hybrid) Zurich or Lausanne.
  • Highly competitive compensation package.

 

This position is based in Zürich.

Don’t worry if you don’t meet all the criteria! We value motivation, pragmatic problem-solving, and potential above all else. We’d love to hear from you and learn more about your passion for driving the AI revolution.

description: Build with us Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together. Your impact Credit, IRRBB and capital models sit at the heart of how a bank measures its own risk. Mollie already uses models in day to day processes, but nobody challenges them independently from a second line perspective yet. As Model Risk Officer, you'll help build the second line model risk function that gives Mollie, and its regulator, confidence that models can be trusted before they're used. This is a true 0 to 1 role. Mollie isn't a bank today, so there's no model risk framework, validation methodology or model inventory to inherit. Your work feeds into our licence application and, once authorised, into how we manage model risk every day. You'll also work with our Machine Learning team and the Domains already deploying models, so you can shape how we manage model risk today, not just in a banking future. Your challenge and sign off will be visible to senior leadership, audit and, eventually, our regulator. As Mollie grows and matures its model risk management, your scope grows from building the framework to running an ongoing model risk cycle. What you'll ship Build and own Mollie's model risk management framework and policy, including model risk appetite, validation standards and the model risk lifecycle. Set up and maintain the model inventory for credit, IRRBB and capital models, with materiality and risk tiering for each. Coordinate independent second line validation and challenge before models are used, including credit risk and ECL, IRRBB, and Pillar 1 and Pillar 2 capital models. Design the ongoing monitoring and re-validation cycle with the Machine Learning team, covering performance testing, limitation tracking and re-validation triggers. Partner with model owners in Credit Risk and Treasury ALM, and coordinate within the second line Risk function, so model risk challenge is built into the wider risk and capital frameworks. Coordinate clear, well documented validation reports and model risk information that stand up to scrutiny from DNB/ECB, external auditors and internal audit. What you'll bring Around 5 to 7 years of experience in model risk management or model validation within a bank, preferably across at least one of credit, IRRBB and capital models. Solid working knowledge of ECB model risk expectations and how model validation should be structured and evidenced. Comfort building a model risk framework and validation approach from the ground up. You're excited to write the first playbook. Strong quantitative skills to critically assess model methodology, assumptions and performance, and the discipline to document your findings so others, including a regulator, can follow them. The ability to explain model limitations and validation findings to model owners and senior stakeholders, and the confidence to hold your ground under challenge. Genuine curiosity about how AI can speed up the parts of model validation that don't need a human, so more of your time goes toward judgement and challenge. At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

At Ripple, we're building a world where value moves like information does today. It's big, it's bold, and we're already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.

If you're ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

The work:

We're seeking a dedicated, passionate, and eager Principal Technical Program Manager to join our team responsible for leading large cross-functional programs linked to our Products. This role reports to the Head of TPM within Ripple Core. This is a challenging and technical role, requiring the expertise to synthesize business and technical requirements and the foresight to ensure we are solving for Ripple's current and future customer needs. You will bring a strong understanding of traditional finance and trading markets, and use it to help bridge the needs of financial institutions with the capabilities of digital asset infrastructure. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams to design robust and scalable systems, lead product schedules, remove roadblocks, and ensure high development velocity. Ideal candidates have a track record of seeing around the corner and providing technical leadership to deliver for customers. You will be responsible for high-level strategy, but also know when to get hands-on to push an initiative forward. You must be passionate about enabling teams to invent and deliver customer-focused solutions to bold and ambiguous challenges.

What you'll do:

  • Develop department-level priorities and strategy across strategic financial product initiatives by deeply understanding our institutional clients, the financial markets they operate in, and the technology that serves them.
  • Reduce ambiguity and risk by proactively identifying and eliminating bottlenecks and obstacles, raising issues strategically, and making sound data-driven decisions that deliver for our customers based on associated trade-offs.
  • Communicate with purpose and clarity, bringing together cross-functional teams to achieve program objectives.
  • Be a role model and an inspiring leader for other TPMs.
  • Create technical frameworks that can be used by engineering teams for decision-making.
  • Improve the efficiency of Operational Excellence processes across the organization.
  • Partner with product, engineering, and business leaders to align development priorities with the needs of financial institutions and market participants, driving alignment across internal teams and external partners such as banks, custodians, and market infrastructure providers.
  • Drive Ripple’s strategic initiatives that bring institutional financial products to market end to end, partnering with executive leadership to set direction, align business units, and translate company goals into executable multi-year programs.
  • Own outcomes across a portfolio of large programs serving financial institutions, anticipating cross-program dependencies and regulatory, operational, and market risks, making trade-off calls at the leadership level, and ensuring delivery translates into measurable client and business impact.

 

What you'll bring:

  • 12+ years of technical program management experience leading large-scale, cross-functional programs in complex financial services or financial technology environments, with a track record of delivering strategic initiatives across multiple organizations and external partners.
  • Deep experience in traditional finance (TradFi), such as banking, asset management, broker-dealers, custodians, or financial market infrastructure, with a strong understanding of the financial services landscape, its key players, and its regulatory environment.
  • Working knowledge of crypto or traditional trading markets, including market structure, liquidity, and the full trade lifecycle from order management and execution through clearing and settlement.
  • Ability to use data and analytics to identify trends and manage the health of programs and systems.
  • Shown understanding and working knowledge of software development and modern project management standard processes, such as Agile, Scrum, Six Sigma, etc.
  • Ability to coordinate multi-functionally, build consensus, and deliver across teams. Able to influence without authority, negotiate, and encourage others in a matrixed environment.
  • Experience with project planning tools such as Jira and Confluence, and proficiency in Google Sheets.
  • Experience crafting or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems.
  • Experience in Payments, Custody, Stablecoin, Prime Brokerage, Tokenization, and/or Blockchain ecosystems.

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

  • The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
  • A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact.  A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
  • Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
  • In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in. 
  • Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
  • We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

  • Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
  • Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
  • Employee giving match
  • Mobile phone stipend

Take Care of Yourself

  • R&R days so you can rest and recharge
  • Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
  • Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
  • Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
  • Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.

description: About Agent F Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention. Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control. We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. These founding roles will shape both the product and the way we build it. About the role You will own how customers experience Agent F, from landing pages and product demonstrations through onboarding and migration to the work they do every day. A founder looking at their finances for the first time and a controller investigating a discrepancy need different levels of detail. Both should understand where they are, what a number means and what to do next. This combines product design with hands-on front-end engineering. You will talk to customers, shape the journey, design the interactions and ship them in the product. You will use AI coding agents to help implement changes, and take responsibility for reviewing the code and checking the finished experience. Your work will connect the product into a coherent whole: consistent navigation, familiar controls and clear explanations across features. You will also own the steps that turn an interested visitor into an active, paying customer. What you will build and improve An engaging path from first interest to a useful result. Connect landing pages and product demonstrations to sign-up, account setup and the first session so a customer understands what to provide and what they will get back. Measure where people abandon the process and address the causes. A migration experience people can follow. Help customers bring in their history from accounting software or spreadsheets. Make upload progress, missing information, validation errors and next steps understandable. A consistent product experience. Develop the design language, navigation and reusable components used across the product. Make tables, forms and reports behave predictably, including loading, empty and error states. Useful decision screens. Design views that help customers compare recommendations, understand costs and choose what happens next. Our planned evidence board brings this information together as customers describe their needs. Interfaces that earn trust. Help users see where a figure came from, understand a proposed change and review it before approval. Include accessibility, keyboard use and clear language in the implementation. Improvements grounded in actual use. Keep up with the customer pipeline, from interested prospects to customers onboarding or migrating. Observe customer sessions and work with the customer-facing team. Turn recurring questions into product changes, then check whether those changes helped. For example, a customer uploads a file and sees a different total from the one they expected. You would design the journey that explains what was imported, what needs checking and how to resolve the difference, working with the data engineer on the underlying evidence. What you bring You have five or more years of experience designing and shipping software, including business-to-business software sold as a service (B2B SaaS). You may come from product design with strong engineering skills, or from front-end engineering with substantial design ownership. You can show a product journey you improved, explain the choices you made and describe the effect on customers. You have owned an onboarding, activation or conversion measure: whether people got started, reached a useful result or became paying customers. Core experience Product design across information architecture, interaction design and visual design. Production front-end work with React, TypeScript, CSS and reusable components, including reviewing and debugging code generated by agents. Building or maintaining a design system that other people use. Customer research, usability testing and product analytics that inform what you ship. Daily use of AI coding agents, with a clear approach to specifications, review and verification. Clear written explanations of design decisions and their trade-offs. Useful additional experience Financial software, complex tables and dashboards, or products where people need to inspect the source of a result. Experience with configuration-driven interfaces, where shared rules and data determine how a screen is assembled, would also be useful. What early progress could look like In your first months, you would map the main customer journeys, establish a baseline for onboarding and conversion, and ship an improvement to a step where customers regularly get stuck. Alongside that, you would start consolidating repeated interface patterns into reusable components. We would look for evidence that customers reach a useful result sooner, complete more of the journey independently and need less help with the interface. The exact priorities will follow the customer needs you find with the team. Operational excellence and customer commitments You take pride in a product customers can depend on under pressure. When sign-up, migration or a critical financial workflow breaks, you step in, establish what the customer needs and work with the team to restore a safe path forward. A misleading balance, missing transaction or incorrect status can be a financial emergency even when the page loads normally. You make the problem visible, help contain its impact and verify the complete customer journey after a fix. Customer commitments shape how we work. You are willing to interrupt planned work, respond promptly and stay engaged when an urgent issue puts a service-level agreement (SLA), onboarding commitment or financial deadline at risk. That requires flexibility beyond normal working hours as part of agreed on-call coverage and coordinated incident response. You keep people informed and see the issue through to a verified recovery or an explicit handover. Afterwards, you improve the system so the same emergency becomes less likely. How you will work This is a senior founding role in a small team, with scope to shape product decisions and engineering practice. You will work closely with the engineers responsible for platform operations and customer data. You will carry work from customer observation through implementation and release, then follow up on how it performs. Everyone shares responsibility for the whole product and the customer outcome. You will pick up the most important work or whatever is on fire, including tasks outside your specialty. You take initiative, bring in the right expertise and stay involved until the problem is resolved. Customer impact and urgency determine where you focus. The role is full-time and in-person in Berlin. German is not required. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
