description:
ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD

NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We’re the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.

We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.

THE ROLE: PRODUCT MANAGER

We’re building a new customer platform, including AI Studio and our machine learning products, largely from scratch. These products need one person who owns what gets built, in what order, and why, and who makes sure what ships solves real problems for teams running AI and ML workloads on our GPU infrastructure. You’ll report to our Chief Product & Technology Officer and lead a team of three Product Engineers, based in London or Australia.

This is a role for someone who’s comfortable shaping loosely defined problems into clear priorities, makes trade-offs and explains them, and takes accountability for adoption and outcomes, not just a delivery plan.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Rather than a checklist, here’s what success in this role actually looks like:

  • Own and drive the product vision and roadmap for the new customer platform, AI Studio and ML products, prioritising ruthlessly across customer needs, commercial goals and engineering capacity.
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing and Security, so products are buildable, supportable, compliant and ready to sell at launch.
  • Run regular discovery with customers and prospects to understand how they build, train, fine-tune and deploy models, and turn what you learn into clear problem statements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Define what a minimum useful release looks like for each product, and sequence delivery so customers get value early rather than at the end of a long build.
  • Lead your team from idea to release: run the planning and delivery cadence, keep the backlog actionable, and remove blockers along the way.
  • Line-manage and develop three Product Engineers, and help hire and build a team that owns problems end to end.
  • Define and track adoption, activation, usage and retention metrics, and use them, alongside the competitive landscape, to decide what to do next.

ABOUT YOU

We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. You’ll likely bring a combination of the following:

Essential:

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager owning technical products end to end, ideally in cloud, developer platforms or infrastructure.
  • A track record of taking a new product from early concept through to launch and adoption.
  • Experience line-managing or directly leading a small team, including performance and development conversations.
  • Enough technical depth to work credibly with engineers on APIs, platform architecture and infrastructure trade-offs.
  • A working understanding of how AI and ML teams build, train and deploy models, and the tooling they rely on.
  • Strong discovery and prioritisation skills, with evidence of turning customer research into roadmap decisions.

Nice to Have:

  • Product experience with GPU cloud, AI/ML platforms, MLOps tooling, or model serving and fine-tuning products.
  • A hands-on technical background, such as software or ML engineering, and conceptual familiarity with Kubernetes, containers and the NVIDIA GPU ecosystem.
  • Experience with usage-based pricing models and working across distributed teams in multiple time zones.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme
  • Employee wellbeing benefits
  • 25 days holiday, plus public holidays
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Enhanced Pension Scheme
  • Flexible working arrangements (remote or hybrid, depending on role and location)
  • Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experiment
  • Visible, meaningful impact as we scale
  • Clear career progression in a high-growth company
  • A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership
  • The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud’s team, culture, and future

WHY APPLY

We welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems and want to build something meaningful at scale, we’d like to hear from you.

MORE INFORMATION

Visit our careers page to learn more about us or follow us on LinkedIn and X to learn more about our journey and keep up with our latest news and releases.

description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We’re looking for a Security Product Manager to join our team. Security Product Manager is responsible for conveying the company’s security strengths to customers, partners and the market at large. This includes participating in relevant security partnership initiatives, influencing security positioning and branding, and working closely with internal teams to ensure company’s security posture and security products is communicated effectively to all stakeholders. By combining expertise in compliance requirements with a customer-centric approach, Security Product Manager helps position security as a competitive advantage rather than just an internal obligation. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

1. Product Management 

  • Define the vision and roadmap for Nebius’ security products. 
  • Owning the ideation, postmortem, prioritization, backlog, and customer feedback processes. 
  • Guiding new features, systems and services from inception to launch, while keeping customers at the center of everything. 

2. Customer-facing communications 

  • Lead public-facing communications around security updates or changes in compliance status. 
  • In the event of a security incident, coordinate user messaging (email notifications, press releases, FAQs) with support from the Head of Security Products and CISO. 
  • Gather user feedback on user experience and security to guide continuous improvements. 

 3. Competitive analysis and market research 

  • Conduct ongoing research on industry benchmarks, emerging security standards and technologies, and competitor certifications. 
  • Identify gaps and opportunities in organization’s product security posture; propose strategic initiatives that differentiate the company’s security story in the market. 
  • Stay informed about new regulations or frameworks that may influence future product certifications or transparency requirements (e.g., privacy laws, data sovereignty standards). 

 4. Certification and audit support, service ownership 

  • Collaborate with the CISO office to gather technical evidence or make necessary product enhancements that satisfy certification requirements. 
  • Take ownership of some security-related services of Cloud platform. 
  • Track and maintain a certification roadmap (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPPA, etc.), working closely with CISO, GRC & Compliance, Corporate Security departments. Communicate timelines, goals and status updates to leadership and sales representatives. 

5. Cross-functional collaboration 

  • Coordinate with multiple Product Managers to align security goals with other product roadmaps, ensuring a consistent narrative between product security and external messaging. 
  • Work with Platform Security, GRC & Corporate Security and legal teams to gather essential information for security products enhancements (e.g., penetration test summaries, compliance reports). 
  • Work with Customer-facing teams to address client inquiries about security posture and guide them on using security features optimally. 

We expect you to have: 

  • 3+ years of Product Management or Program Management experience with a focus on security initiatives. 
  • Basic knowledge of compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR) and familiarity with how they translate into business value. 
  • Proven ability to communicate technical concepts in a clear, customer-friendly manner (e.g., writing content, speaking at webinars or conferences). 
  • Stakeholder management skills to align with other Product Managers, CISO staff, engineering, marketing, and customer-facing teams. 
  • Analytical mindset: comfortable defining success metrics (e.g., security feature adoption, NPS around trust, certification progress) and making data-driven decisions. 
  • Project management skills: demonstrated ability to manage inter-team collaboration within company-wide projects, ensuring timely delivery of cross-functional tasks and alignment with compliance goals. 

It will be an added bonus if you have:

description: This role is also open to candidates living in the EU or EEA. We can't consider applications from other locations. If you've built something before, start here Most ML jobs hand you a benchmark. This one hands you a business problem with paying customers and their real data. Construction tenders are long, messy and full of trade jargon, and every decision a customer makes on our platform becomes a labeled example you can train on. We need someone who can turn that data into models that customers notice: from the first experiment to the model serving production traffic, and back again when a customer says it got something wrong. If you've founded a company (whether it worked out or not), been the first ML engineer somewhere, or shipped a model people paid for, this role was written for you. About Scalera Scalera is an ETH Zurich spin-off building AI for the €200B+ European construction industry. Manufacturers, wholesalers and suppliers in Switzerland, Austria and Germany still run their most document-heavy work by hand, from reading 300-page tenders to retyping purchase orders into their ERP. We automate that work one process at a time, and ML sits at the center of every one of them. What you'll own You'll own the ML behind our products, end to end. In practice that means: Training and fine-tuning: embedding models, rerankers, classifiers and LLMs, trained on our own data. Document understanding: models that pull structure, quantities and product specs out of tenders, orders and catalogs. Product matching: retrieval and LLM agents that match tender positions to the right products. Evaluation: offline benchmarks, per-customer evals and gates that keep a new model from shipping if it makes things worse. Training and serving infrastructure: automated retrain pipelines, GPU serving and vector search in production. Customer problems: when a model gets something wrong for a customer, finding out why and fixing it. What success looks like after 3 months There's a model or part of the pipeline people now think of as yours, and you're the one deciding what happens to it next. You've spotted a problem nobody asked you to solve, made the case for it, and shipped a first version. A model you trained runs in production, and customers can see the difference in their results. Retraining runs automatically, and nothing reaches customers without passing an eval you designed. You've cut LLM cost or latency by replacing an expensive step with a smaller model of your own. You've decided at least one thing we should stop building. You'll probably thrive here if You've taken something from zero to one: a company, a model in production, or a side project with real users. You've trained and fine-tuned models yourself, ideally embeddings, retrieval or document models, and evaluated them honestly on held-out data. You've built with LLMs in production and know where agents fail. You write strong Python and can run what you build: Docker, CI/CD, and cloud on GCP, AWS or Azure. You measure before you believe, and a single aggregate score doesn't convince you. You'd rather open a customer's actual document than wait for a spec. You're comfortable with ambiguity. You can make progress while the problem is still half-defined, which at a startup it usually is. You want a large scope of responsibility and are happy to own things well beyond your job title. Rapidly changing requirements don't throw you. When customers or priorities shift, you adapt and keep going. You enjoy direct customer contact and want to be on customer calls. You write clearly in English. German is a plus, not a requirement. You probably won't enjoy it if You just want to code and go home. You don't like talking to customers. Ambiguity and chaos bother you. You want a well-defined research agenda handed to you. You'd rather hand a model to someone else to deploy and debug. Your main goal is managing people soon. Here, scope grows with what you own, not with headcount. Our stack Python and PyTorch, open-weight and frontier LLMs, LangGraph, Langfuse, PostgreSQL with pgvector, Pinecone, and GCP. You don't need to know all of it on day one. How we hire Screening call (30 min) with our VP Engineering. It's two-way: ask us anything, including the hard questions. Technical deep-dive call: walk us through a model or system you built, the decisions you made and what went wrong in production. Meet Scalera Day: come to our office in Zürich, work on a real problem with real (anonymized) tender data, and meet the team. Offer: if it's a fit on both sides, we'll move quickly to an offer. Working at Scalera Zürich HQ, four days in the office, Fridays remote. If not located in Zürich then this role is open to remote within the EU or EEA, Occasional customer visits across Switzerland, Austria and Germany Small team, no bureaucracy. You'll work directly with the CEO, CTO, VP Engineering and Customer Success Competitive salary and meaningful equity Founders and former founders: if you're unsure whether you fit, send a few lines about what you built and why you moved on. description:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provides clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns. 

Position Overview

CRA’s Life Sciences practice helps pharmaceutical, biotechnology, diagnostics and medical device companies achieve optimum performance across key aspects of their business, including innovation, commercial success, organization, and reputation, all for the long-term benefit of patients, clinicians, employees, and shareholders. We work with life sciences businesses directly as well as with their legal counsel, industry associations, government organizations, and advocacy groups from the earliest stages of research into new therapy areas, through product development, to the delivery of products that will achieve commercial success and fulfill the expectations of our clients and their key stakeholders.

Senior Associates at CRA work on project teams with senior and junior consultants on a variety of client engagements across industries. Senior Associates conduct advanced strategic analysis and assist in the management of consulting projects. They serve as a project manager, direct the work of others, oversee analysis, manage mid-level client relationships, and/or communicate project results. Staff at this level are expected to work independently with minimal supervision.

To be successful in this role, you must be able to effectively plan and manage the execution of smaller projects or significant sub-tasks on larger, more complex projects, conceptualize and analyse issues, and perform or direct a wide variety of analytical tasks. We also highly value a strong work ethic, creativity, a positive attitude, and a high level of energy. At this time, we are specifically seeking consultants with strong knowledge of pricing and access systems in Europe and globally. Typical Senior Associate responsibilities include:

  • Independently identify/design analytic tasks and contribute to the development of overall analytic framework for consulting projects;
  • Interface with client representatives to communicate developments and present results;
  • Draft reports or presentations, or sections of reports or presentations;
  • Contribute to project planning and budget management efforts;
  • Provide training and technical supervision to less-experienced staff, including reviewing their analyses and providing coaching/direction;
  • Contribute to business development efforts and draft client proposals.

Desired Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in life sciences (e.g., biology, biotechnology, biochemistry, pharmacology, chemistry etc.) or a relevant analytical degree, with significant work experience;
  • 3-6 years previous consulting experience;
  • Strong skills in quantitative and qualitative analysis methods and techniques;
  • Proven staff and project management skills;
  • Client interaction, facilitation, presentation, budgeting, and project planning skills;
  • Strong knowledge of pricing and market access issues in the European markets (and globally);
  • Occasional travel required.

To Apply

To be considered for this position, we require the following:

  • Resume – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;
  • Cover letter – please describe your interest in CRA and how this role matches your goals.

Career Growth and Benefits 

  • CRA’s robust skills development programs, including a commitment to offering training annually through formal and informal programs, encouraging you to thrive as an individual and team member. Beginning with skill building, training continues with technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.
  • We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.  

Our Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Über Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates ist eine führende globale Beratungsfirma, die wirtschaftliche, finanzielle und betriebswirtschaftliche Expertise für große Anwaltskanzleien, Unternehmen und Regierungen weltweit bietet. CRA berät Kunden in wirtschaftlichen und finanziellen Angelegenheiten im Zusammenhang mit Rechtsstreitigkeiten und behördlichen Verfahren und unterstützt Unternehmen bei kritischen Geschäftsstrategien und leistungsbezogenen Fragen. Seit 1965 engagieren Kunden CRA aufgrund der Kombination aus Branchenerfahrung und rigoroser, faktenbasierter Analyse, die klare, umsetzbare Lösungen für komplexe Geschäftsprobleme bietet.

Stellenübersicht

Die Life Sciences Practice von CRA hilft Pharma-, Biotechnologie-, Medtech- und Digital-Health-Unternehmen, optimale Leistungen in wichtigen Geschäftsbereichen wie kommerzielle Strategie, Preisgestaltung und Zugang, Innovation, Organisationsstruktur, Politikanalyse, medizinische Angelegenheiten, Stakeholder-Management und Marketing zu erzielen – alles zum langfristigen Nutzen von Patienten, Ärzten, Mitarbeitern und Aktionären. Wir arbeiten direkt mit Life-Sciences-Unternehmen sowie mit deren Rechtsberatern, Industrieverbänden, Regierungsorganisationen und Interessengruppen zusammen.

Senior Associates bei CRA arbeiten gemeinsam mit erfahrenen und jüngeren Consultants in Projektteams an einer Vielzahl von Kundenprojekten in unterschiedlichen Branchen. Sie führen anspruchsvolle strategische Analysen durch und unterstützen bei der Steuerung von Beratungsprojekten. Dabei übernehmen sie die Projektleitung, koordinieren die Arbeit anderer Teammitglieder, verantworten Analysen, betreuen Kundenbeziehungen auf mittlerer Ebene und/oder kommunizieren Projektergebnisse. In dieser Position arbeiten Sie weitgehend selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich.

Für eine erfolgreiche Tätigkeit in dieser Position sollten Sie in der Lage sein, kleinere Projekte oder wesentliche Teilaufgaben größerer und komplexerer Projekte effektiv zu planen und zu steuern, Fragestellungen zu strukturieren und zu analysieren sowie ein breites Spektrum analytischer Aufgaben selbst durchzuführen oder anzuleiten. Darüber hinaus legen wir großen Wert auf eine ausgeprägte Arbeitsethik, Kreativität, eine positive Einstellung und ein hohes Maß an Engagement.

Aktuell suchen wir insbesondere Consultants mit fundierten Kenntnissen der Pricing- und Market-Access-Systeme in Europa und weltweit.

Aufgaben

  • Sie identifizieren und konzipieren eigenständig die erforderlichen Analysen und wirken an der Entwicklung des übergreifenden analytischen Ansatzes für Beratungsprojekte mit.
  • Sie stehen im direkten Austausch mit unseren Kunden, informieren sie über den Projektfortschritt und präsentieren Ergebnisse.
  • Sie erstellen Berichte und Präsentationen oder übernehmen die Ausarbeitung einzelner Abschnitte.
  • Sie wirken bei der Projektplanung und der Steuerung von Projektbudgets mit.
  • Sie unterstützen weniger erfahrene Teammitglieder bei ihrer fachlichen Weiterentwicklung, prüfen deren Analysen und geben ihnen fachliche Anleitung und Feedback.
  • Sie bringen sich in die Geschäftsentwicklung ein und wirken bei der Erstellung von Angeboten für Kunden mit.

Gewünschte Qualifikationen

  • Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss im Bereich Life Sciences, z. B. in Biologie, Biotechnologie, Biochemie, Pharmakologie oder Chemie, oder in einem relevanten Studiengang mit analytischem Schwerpunkt sowie einschlägige Berufserfahrung
  • 3 bis 6 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Beratung
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse und Erfahrung in der Anwendung quantitativer und qualitativer Analysemethoden
  • Nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Mitarbeiterführung und im Projektmanagement
  • Erfahrung im direkten Kundenkontakt, in der Moderation und Präsentation sowie in der Budget- und Projektplanung
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse zu Pricing und Market Access in europäischen und internationalen Märkten
  • Deutschkenntnisse von Vorteil
  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen

Bewerbung

Um für diese Position berücksichtigt zu werden, reichen Sie bitte die folgenden Unterlagen ein:

  • Lebenslauf – bitte geben Sie Ihre aktuelle Adresse, eprsönliche E-Mail-Adresse und Telefonnummer an;
  • Anschreiben – Bitte beschreiben Sie Ihr Interesse an CRA und wie diese Rolle zu Ihren Zielen passt.

Karriereentwicklung und Benefits

  • CRA bietet Ihnen vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung. Dazu gehören jährliche formelle und informelle Weiterbildungsangebote, die Ihre individuelle Entwicklung ebenso fördern wie Ihre Zusammenarbeit im Team. Das Angebot reicht von Trainings zur Weiterentwicklung Ihrer fachlichen und persönlichen Kompetenzen über Präsentationstrainings und interne Seminare bis hin zu individuellem Karriere-Mentoring und Performance-Coaching durch eine erfahrene Kollegin oder einen erfahrenen Kollegen. Darüber hinaus bieten interne Initiativen die Möglichkeit, zusätzliche Führungsverantwortung zu übernehmen und sich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung von CRA einzubringen.
  • Wir bieten Ihnen ein umfassendes Vergütungs- und Leistungspaket mit attraktiven Zusatzleistungen. Dazu gehören Angebote zur Förderung Ihres körperlichen, mentalen, emotionalen und finanziellen Wohlbefindens sowie interne Unterstützung bei Einwanderungs- und Visaangelegenheiten für internationale Mitarbeitende und Geschäftsreisende.

Flexibilität am Arbeitsplatz

CRA schafft ein Arbeitsumfeld, das es unseren Kollegen ermöglicht, von der Zusammenarbeit im Büro zu profitieren, um unser Versprechen von beruflichem Wachstum, Mentoring und Inklusivität bestmöglich zu erfüllen. Gleichzeitig erkennen wir an, dass Einzelpersonen eine Reihe von Vorteilen genießen, wenn sie periodisch von zu Hause aus arbeiten. Derzeit bitten wir Mitarbeiter, im Durchschnitt 3 bis 4 Tage die Woche im Büro zu arbeiten (was Reisen zu einem anderen CRA-Büro oder zum Standort eines Kunden einschließen kann). Zu bestimmten Zeiten des Jahres (z.B. Feiertagsperioden) werden zusätzliche Remote-Arbeitsoptionen für diejenigen angeboten, deren Arbeitsverpflichtungen dies zulassen, obwohl unsere Büros für diejenigen, die dort sein möchten oder müssen, geöffnet bleiben.

 

Verantwortungsvoller Einsatz von KI im Recruiting

Bei CRA verstehen wir Recruiting als eine Tätigkeit, bei der Menschen eine zentrale Rolle spielen. KI und andere digitale Tools unterstützen uns zwar dabei, effizienter zu arbeiten, ersetzen jedoch nicht den persönlichen Austausch mit unseren Bewerberinnen und Bewerbern. Entsprechend erwarten wir auch von Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten, dass sie sich persönlich mit CRA und ihrer Bewerbung auseinandersetzen und sich auf die Gespräche mit uns vorbereiten. Weitere Informationen zum angemessenen Einsatz von KI im Recruiting bei CRA finden Sie auf unserer Website.

Unser Engagement für Vielfalt

Charles River Associates ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit bietet. Im Rahmen unseres Fokus auf Gerechtigkeit und Inklusion arbeiten wir daran, einen fairen und konsistenten Einstellungsprozess sicherzustellen. Wir feiern Vielfalt und sind für ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld engagiert.

description: This role is open only to candidates living in the EU or EEA. We can't consider applications from other locations. If you've built something before, start here The hardest part of a startup usually isn't the code. It's finding customers who really need what you build and getting them to change how they work. At Scalera, that part is done: manufacturers, suppliers and contractors across Switzerland, Austria and Germany already run their tenders through us every day. What we need now are people who can take the next unsolved problem and turn it into a product customers can't do without. If you've founded a company (whether it worked out or not), been the first engineer somewhere, or built something people paid for, this role was written for you. About Scalera Scalera is an ETH Zurich spin-off building AI for the €200B+ European construction industry. Large manufacturers and suppliers still run their most document-heavy processes by hand, from reading 300-page tenders to retyping purchase orders into their ERP. We automate them one by one. Our product matching already handles 1,400 tender positions in 16 minutes at 98% precision, work that used to take a sales rep most of a day. What you'll do You'll be part product manager, part engineer. You'll spend real time with customers and help shape what we build. Sometimes you'll spot the next problem yourself, and sometimes we'll hand you a clear priority to run with. Spend real time with customers. Join calls and site visits, sit with the people who do the work, and understand why they do it the way they do. You'll know their problems firsthand, not from a ticket. Shape what to build. Turn what you hear into a clear problem, a scope and a plan, and push back when the obvious request isn't the real need. When we bring you a priority, you'll own how it gets solved. Build it. Design and build backend services in Go and Python that turn messy tenders, catalogs and purchase orders into data customers can rely on. Ship, then check. Get it in front of customers fast, watch how they actually use it, and iterate. Own it in production. When something breaks at a customer, it's yours to understand and fix. Build with AI. Use AI heavily in how you work, and design systems that agents can use as well as people. What success looks like after 3 months There's a part of the product people now think of as yours, and you're the one deciding what happens to it next You've spotted a problem nobody asked you to solve, made the case for it, and shipped a first version You've shipped features from both sources: priorities we set and ideas from your own customer conversations At least once, you've talked us out of building something customers didn't really need You've left a part of the platform simpler than you found it You'll probably thrive here if You've taken something from zero to one: a company, a product line, or a side project with paying users You've built and run backend systems in production that other people depend on. We care more about your judgment than your language; you're strong in Go or Python and happy to work in both You're solid on data modeling, API design and messy real-world data You'd rather talk to a customer than wait for a spec You're comfortable with ambiguity. You can make progress while the problem is still half-defined, which at a startup it usually is You want a large scope of responsibility and are happy to own things well beyond your job title Rapidly changing requirements don't throw you. When customers or priorities shift, you adapt and keep going You enjoy direct customer contact and want to be on customer calls You make things simpler over time, not more clever You write clearly in English. German is a plus, not a requirement You probably won't enjoy it if You just want to code and go home You don't like talking to customers, whether on calls or on the occasional site visit Ambiguity and chaos bother you You want a well-defined backlog handed to you Your main goal is managing people soon. Here, scope grows with what you own, not with headcount Our stack Go and Python (FastAPI), PostgreSQL, GCP, and LLMs throughout the document pipeline. You don't need to know all of it on day one. How we hire Screening call (30 min) with our VP Engineering. It's two-way: ask us anything, including the hard questions. Technical deep-dive call: walk us through something you built from scratch, the decisions you made and what went wrong. Meet Scalera Day: join us remotely to work on a real problem with real (anonymized) construction documents, and meet the team. Offer: if it's a fit on both sides, we'll move quickly to an offer. Working at Scalera Remote within the EU or EEA Small team, no bureaucracy. You'll work directly with the CEO, CTO, VP Engineering and Customer Success Competitive compensation Founders and former founders: if you're unsure whether you fit, send a few lines about what you built and why you moved on. ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

  • Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • 3,000 Tideans globally
  • Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE TEAM

We’re the UK’s leading provider of smart current accounts for sole traders and small companies. We’re also on a mission to save business owners time and money on their banking and finance admin so they can get back to doing what they love - for too long, these customers have been under-served by the big banks.

Funding Options joined the Tide family in early 2023 to lead their Partner Credit Services offering. Through their panel of 100 leading lender partners, Funding Options supports UK SMEs to get the right finance in place so they can trade, plan and grow with confidence. Through their multi award-winning platform, Funding Cloud, they can effectively match customers to the right lender and finance product that best suits their needs in minutes with funding decisions in as little as 20 seconds, giving every customer a 5 Star experience whether successful or not, through our sheer professionalism and outstanding standard of customer service.

Our offices are in London -UK, Sofia - Bulgaria, Belgrade - Serbia and Hyderabad -India, where our teams are dedicated to our small business members; revolutionising business banking for SMEs. 

We’re scaling at speed with a focus on hiring talented individuals with a growth mindset and ownership mentality, who are able to juggle multiple and sometimes changing priorities. Our values show our commitment to working as one team, working collaboratively to take action and deliver results. Member first, we are passionate about our members and put them first. We are data-driven, we make decisions, creating insight using data.

We’re also one of LinkedIn’s top 10 hottest UK companies to work for.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

We are looking for a Senior Business Finance Specialist (Senior Commercial Finance Broker) to join our Sales Team and help as many customers as possible access the right finance, through effective conversations - Taking the time to understand about the businesses you engage with (how they work, growth plans, challenges, their experience of finance so far) and understanding customers’ finance needs and effectively matching them to the best product and lender that meets their need…. giving every customer a 5 Star experience whether successful or not, through our sheer professionalism and mind-blowing standard of customer service.

SOME OF THE THINGS YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Contact, engage and manage our Small Business customers through their application process
  • Build and nurture working relationships with our commercial lending partners 
  • Become confident in articulating the Funding Options proposition and service
  • Outbound prospect customers from our CRM
  • Working closely with our Lead Generation team, including providing feedback and advice where appropriate
  • Building on your knowledge of business finance, and gaining an in-depth understanding of the wide variety of lenders and products in the market
  • Confidently articulating the different finance options available to customers across multiple business finance product classes
  • Maintaining accurate, up-to-date information on any prospects that you speak with (in Salesforce)
  • Monitoring and identify trends whilst adding new or enhanced customer profile information into Salesforce
  • Keeping up to date on industry trends, market & competition.
  • Actively share stories and successes to the wider organisation through relevant comms channels.

WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT:

  • Ideally you have experience of Commercial Finance or at least experience in a customer facing sales role
  • Experience working in a 360 sales role and/or outbound prospecting experience
  • You will be able to demonstrate a track record of successfully meeting and exceeding revenue based targets
  • You’ll have excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • You will be able to demonstrate a results-oriented work ethic with impeccable attention to detail, determination and drive
  • You’ll be obsessive about delivering the highest level of customer service
  • You will be extremely well organised and analytical and work well under pressure
  • You can troubleshoot issues quickly and effectively
  • You will be able to engage and quickly establish strong working relationships
  • You’re a self-starter who doesn’t wait for instruction, and who works backwards from targets to ensure effective execution.

WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN

Make work, work for you! We are embracing new ways of working and support flexible working arrangements. With our Working Out of Office (WOO) policy our colleagues can work remotely from home or anywhere in their home country. Additionally, you can work from a different country for up to 90 days a year. Plus, you’ll get:

  • Competitive salary 
  • Vitality Health Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical wellbeing
  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme
  • 25 days holiday with the ability to buy extra days
  • Professional L&D budget 
  • Access to ‘salary sacrifice’ benefits such as Cycle to Work scheme and pension contribution
  • Spacious brand new office in Liverpool street with an all-day snacks bar
  • Enhanced family-friendly leave
  • 24 hours paid volunteering time off per year
  • Flexible working options
  • Sabbatical leave 

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

Jedes Produkt ist somit geschäftskritisch und ist von strategischer Relevanz. Gemeinsam machen wir “mission impossible possible”. Unser Team besteht aus 300+ Members aus der ganzen Welt. In unseren Büros in Hamburg und Lissabon bauen wir gemeinsam Produkte, die noch nie jemand zuvor entwickelt hat. Unsere Teams arbeiten datengetrieben, um ihre eigene Produktivität ständig zu optimieren. Jedes Teammitglied übernimmt die “end-to-end” Verantwortung für seine Arbeit. Um erfolgreich zu sein, muss man produktiv sein. Um produktiv zu sein, muss man effizient und effektiv sein. Technology never rests. Neither do we. ÜBER DEINEN JOB Zusammen mit unserem CEO übernimmst du Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Geschäftsentwicklung bei freiheit.com Dafür hast du immer ein klares Ziel im Blick: Den Erfolg Deiner Kunden. Enge Kundenbeziehungen sind für uns selbstverständlich, als verlässlicher Partner bist du öfters beim Kunden vor Ort und identifizierst mit ihm zusammen seine wichtigen strategischen Ziele. Du bist strategischer Berater der Geschäftsführung und pflegst interne und externe Beziehungen. Client Success Deine Verantwortung ist die kaufmännische Projektsteuerung und die erfolgreiche Projektumsetzung, immer zusammen mit unseren Engineering Teams. Mit Start und Ausbau eines Projektes stellst Du gemeinsam mit den Engineering Directors das für das Projekt optimale Engineering Team auf. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Engineering Teams zusammen und identifizierst evtl. Frictions in dem jeweiligen Projekt. Deine Verantwortung ist es, diese zu beseitigen und damit sicherzustellen, dass das Engineering Team effektiv und effizient arbeiten kann und unsere “Optimal Work Environment” sichergestellt ist. Du bist der Projektmanager und initiierst und moderierst regelmäßige Meetings, Review Sessions, Steering Committees. Client Development Zusätzlich entwickelst du Business und konvertierst unsere Leads zu Bestandskunden. Du pflegst und erweiterst kontinuierlich Dein Netzwerk, verstehst die Potenziale bei unseren Kunden und fokussierst Dich zusammen mit dem Engineering aktiv auf den Kundenausbau. ÜBER DICH Du hast 5-6 Jahre Arbeitserfahrung in einem anspruchsvollen Umfeld (Konzern, Top-Tier Beratung oder Ähnliches). Du hast einen erstklassigen Hochschulabschluss im Bereich der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder Ähnlichem. Du bist im Herzen Unternehmer und hast ein ausgeprägtes “Customer-First Mindset” und ein erstklassiges Gespür im Umgang mit Kunden. Idealerweise hast Du Erfahrung bei der kommerziellen Planung und Auslieferung von komplexen large-scale Software-Projekten. Du bist begeistert von Technologie und erstklassigem Software Engineering. Du arbeitest sehr präzise und bist sicher im Umgang mit Zahlen. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (mind. C1) und verhandlungssicheres Englisch. Du fühlst Dich wohl im Umgang mit Engineers & Non-Engineers, bist offen und ehrlich und arbeitest gern im Team. Du hast Durchhaltevermögen und “Situational Awareness” mit absolutem Willen zum Erfolg. description:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Enterprise Value Creation practice in London is growing, and we are looking for a Senior Consultant to join the team. 

Expectations of value have changed. The EVC team helps clients achieve sustainable P&L improvement, addressing short-term financial priorities while building long-term value for shareholders. We bring a private equity mindset to enterprises, and we differentiate ourselves through the rigour of our thinking and the humanity of our execution: we combine deep data and analysis with market knowledge, and we work side by side with clients so that value is realised and sustained.​

Our cost transformation work helps organisations become more efficient while protecting the capabilities they need to grow – from gross margin and SG&A to third-party spend and operational efficiency. You will work with clients across our industry sectors: Financial Services, Products & Services, Energy & Resources, Pharmaceuticals & Life Sciences, and Central Government.​

What you will be doing

  • Work with clients to understand their cost base and margin drivers, building baselines and identifying improvement opportunities​
  • Build financial models and cost analyses (e.g. spend analysis, cost-to-serve, benchmarking) that turn data into clear, practical recommendations​
  • Contribute to the design and delivery of cost and margin improvement programmes, from diagnostic through to implementation​
  • Track and report the value delivered, helping clients ensure savings are realised and sustained​
  • Help clients build their own capability through knowledge transfer, so that improvements last​
  • Work closely with colleagues across Baringa to bring the right expertise to each client​
  • Support the development of more junior colleagues and contribute to growing the London EVC team

 
Your skills and experience  

We are looking for curious, collaborative people with typically 3 to 6 years of relevant experience who enjoy solving complex problems and seeing their work make a measurable difference for clients. This role is pitched at Senior Consultant level. We also welcome applications from candidates at Consultant and Manager level, and will confirm the level through the interview process.​

  • University degree in Economics, Econometrics, Business, Finance, Accounting or a related field and/or experience in cost analysis, cost transformation, FP&A, spend analysis, or a similar area, gained in consulting or in industry​
  • Strong financial modelling and quantitative analysis skills, and the ability to turn analysis into actionable insight​
  • Experience in a strategy firm, Big 4 or similar advisory firm, investment banking, audit or M&A advisory​
  • Ability to break down complex problems, identify the key messages and communicate them clearly, in writing and in person​
  • A collaborative approach and comfort working with clients and colleagues at all levels​
  • Ability to travel internationally for up to 30% of the time, and to travel and work within the EU/UK

Nice to have:​

  • ACCA, CIMA or CFA qualification (completed or in progress)​
  • Exposure to SG&A, third-party cost, zero-based budgeting or operating model work​
  • Experience in a deals environment or operational due diligence​

We know that strong candidates do not always meet every requirement. If this role interests you and you meet many of the criteria, we encourage you to apply. We are happy to discuss flexible working arrangements. 

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

Join us

All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. Please contact a member of our Recruitment Team to discuss further.

description:
Who/What is Artefact?
Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital, and analytics to help clients achieve tangible
business impact.
With 1,800+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 23 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. Our Zurich office is at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.

The role:
 
We are looking for a Senior Data & AI Architect who combines business strategy and technology across Data and GenAI. You will design the operating model and the organization of the Data & GenAI CoE, define the target architecture, and steer data products from demand through to rollout.
 
Key responsibilities:
 
Operating model and organization
  • Design the Data & AI operating model (centralized, federated, hub-and-spoke) following Data Mesh principles: roles, responsibilities, domain ownership and governance mechanisms.
  • Define the organization of the Data & GenAI CoE: scope, service catalogue, skills, sizing and engagement model with business domains.
  • Design end-to-end processes for demand management, use case prioritization, funding and value tracking.
Architecture and technology choices
  • Define the target data platform architecture on cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) and Databricks, including GenAI components (RAG, agents, vector stores, LLMOps).
  • Run make-or-buy analyses and vendor selections: scouting, evaluation criteria, business case, TCO and final recommendation.
  • Check that architecture, security and data governance choices are consistent with enterprise standards and with the operating model.
Data products: from demand to rollout
  • Gather and formalize functional requirements with the business, translating them into data products with owners, consumers, SLAs and quality metrics.
  • Design data products from both a functional angle (use cases, KPIs, impacted processes) and a technical one (data model, pipelines, interfaces, serving layer).
  • Act as design authority during implementation: review system integrator solutions and oversee quality, progress and risks of the rollout.
Requirements:
  • At least 4 years of professional experience in IT.
  • At least 2 years on projects focused on AI/GenAI, Data Mesh and functional requirements gathering.
  • Consulting experience, ideally in strategy consulting, combined with experience at a system integrator or delivery firm.
  • Hands-on experience designing operating models, Data/AI organizations or CoEs.
  • Experience with make-or-buy analyses, vendor selection or target architecture definition.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
Technical and functional skills:
You will not be expected to write code, but you need to know the technologies well enough to assess them, challenge vendors and spot a flawed setup.
  • Data Mesh and governance: domain ownership, data products, federated governance, data contracts, catalogues and lineage (e.g. Unity Catalog, OpenMetadata, Collibra).
  • Cloud: data and AI PaaS services on at least one of Azure, AWS and GCP; security, networking and FinOps principles.
  • Databricks: Lakehouse, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows; ability to assess design and cost.
  • GenAI: RAG and agentic architectures, LLMOps, model evaluation, platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI and Bedrock.
  • Operating model: Data/AI organization, CoE, roles (data owner, data steward, product owner), demand and portfolio processes.
  • Requirements and delivery: requirements gathering, user stories, process modelling, agile methods, programme governance.
  • Business: business cases, TCO, value tracking, and the ability to translate technical choices into economic impact.
Nice to have:
  • German not strictly required.
  • Experience with clients in pharma sector.
  • Cloud or Databricks certifications (e.g. Azure Solutions Architect, Databricks Data Engineer or Solutions Architect).
  • Experience in tech due diligence or post-merger transformation projects.
  • Prior technical background as an engineer or developer.
What we offer:
  • A role bridging strategy and technology, with direct impact on client decisions.
  • International projects on Data Mesh, data platforms and GenAI.
  • Close collaboration with the Project Lead and a growth path towards programme leadership roles.
  • Location and working model: (Hybrid) Zurich or Lausanne.
  • Highly competitive compensation package

This position is based in Zürich.

Don’t worry if you don’t meet all the criteria! We value motivation, pragmatic problem-solving, and potential above all else. We’d love to hear from you and learn more about your passion for driving the AI revolution.

description: Fastned is one of Europe's leading fast-charging networks. Active across nine countries, we have spent nearly 15 years building the infrastructure, expertise and brand that define premium fast charging in Europe. What sets us apart is our focus on reliability, sustainability and the energy transition. We have been awarded “Best Charging Network” in the UK, France, Switzerland and the Netherlands, further establishing Fastned as a leading player in the field. This is your opportunity to make a lasting impact and help us accelerate our operations in the DACH region to the next level! Join Fastned at the forefront of Europe’s electric vehicle and charging infrastructure revolution. The role is based in our beautiful office in Cologne, where your over 50 future colleagues cannot wait to meet you! Your role As Senior Operations Manager DACH, you will initially focus on Germany and Switzerland while helping shape the future of operations across the wider DACH region, including Austria as the organisation expands. Germany is entering a major growth phase, with the network expected to expand significantly in the coming years. You will help design an operating model that can absorb this growth while keeping uptime above 99%, improving customer experience and managing costs and team growth responsibly. You will have significant ownership of how operations are run in Germany and Switzerland. As the key operational point of contact for German, Swiss and future Austrian stations, you will work closely with country and central teams, as well as contractors and service providers. Your scope spans preventive maintenance of chargers and stations, station appearance and amenities, reactive maintenance, spare parts logistics, and the continuous improvement of our operations and processes. Within the broader direction set by Fastned, you will define priorities, improve the operating model and make pragmatic decisions that keep the region performing as the network grows. Your responsibilities Team leadership Lead and grow the DACH field team. Supervising, coaching and developing a team of five Field Engineers and a Station Manager, with a Maintenance Coordinator joining over time, ensuring they work safely, efficiently and as one strong team. Managing team capacity, prioritising work and dispatching jobs in the most efficient way across the Swiss and German network. Bringing structure to the team’s priorities and ways of working, helping ensure maintenance work is completed on time and the network remains safe, reliable and available for our customers. Creating a strong safety culture by ensuring full compliance with Health & Safety standards and regulatory requirements, and providing a safe and caring work environment for colleagues on the road and on site. Operational excellence Ensure high uptime and a great station experience. Being accountable for all day-to-day operations of Fastned stations in the DACH region, from chargers and systems to the overall look and feel of our sites. Ensuring we maintain network uptime above 99% in your region through effective preventive maintenance plans and swift, high-quality reactive repairs. Managing a network of partners responsible for maintaining and servicing our stations. Supporting improvements to the customer experience and your team in the field by regularly visiting stations, performing site inspections and quality audits, with a strong focus on safety and customer experience. Overseeing the handover of new stations in the DACH region from Construction to Field Operations, ensuring they meet our operational, safety and quality standards from day one. Managing spare parts flows together with our Supply Chain team to optimise local stock levels, minimise downtime and ensure that engineers always have the right parts at the right time. Leading and coordinating with external partners larger infrastructure works at your stations. Continuously improving how we work by taking local initiatives, standardising best practices, simplifying processes and using data and insights to make better decisions. Customer, stakeholder and partner management Delivering a best-in-class customer experience by ensuring stations are always clean, safe and easy to use, with strong attention to detail across lighting, signage, landscaping, cleanliness and amenities. Collaborating closely with Customer Operations and other internal teams to monitor performance, respond to incidents and ensure a smooth, end-to-end customer journey across the network. Acting as the voice of DACH Operations within the leadership team and central organisations, representing operational priorities and insights. Initiating, developing and maintaining strong relationships with external partners and contractors, such as electrical contractors, cleaning, landscaping and civil works providers. Providing operational input into new station designs, upgrades and local initiatives to ensure operational excellence is embedded from the outset. You will report to our Director of Operations, based in Amsterdam. The role is based in Germany and involves regular travel across the DACH region to visit stations and team members, as well as occasional travel to our Amsterdam headquarters. Who are we looking for? You are a seasoned field operations leader who can both set direction and get things done on the ground. You combine a strategic mindset with strong operational experience, and you are excited to scale and professionalise Fastned’s German and Swiss operations. You think in terms of network performance, customer experience and long-term capabilities, while also being comfortable jumping into the details when needed to remove blockers for your team. In addition, you meet most of the following criteria: You have at least eight years of relevant experience in operations roles. You have proven experience scaling or professionalising operations in a growing market, for example by building teams, introducing new ways of working, improving performance and enhancing customer experience. You are a strong people leader who coaches and develops your team, communicates clearly and stands your ground when needed, leads by example in the field, and creates a safe, high-performance culture. You combine a strategic mindset, including the ability to set a vision for DACH Operations, define priorities and align stakeholders, with hands-on senior operational experience. You are comfortable going on site, understanding technical issues and making pragmatic trade-offs. You remain calm and organised under pressure, can manage multiple priorities at once and maintain a positive, can-do attitude. You are a strong communicator and stakeholder manager, able to connect the needs of the German and Swiss operations with those of our central teams and influence decisions where needed. You are fluent in English and German. Any additional European language is a plus. Join us in building a better future We work hard to change the world, but we do not forget to recognise and celebrate our successes, big and small. We value work-life balance, offer real work flexibility and have family-friendly policies in place. We have an inclusive work environment and love authentic people, so do not try to fit in because we like you for who you are! A fully electric company car, with all charging expenses covered. 29 days of annual leave. Two Mission Days each year to support a cause you care about or contribute to our mission. A company bonus plan that recognises the impact you make. A Deutschlandticket covered by Fastned. An annual personal development budget of €3,000, because there is always more to learn and improve. Mental wellbeing support through nilo health. A subsidised Urban Sports Club membership. Access to women’s health experts through our partnership with Flouria. A laptop and phone of your choice, with an EU-wide mobile phone plan. Daily vegetarian lunches, snacks and drinks at our office locations. Team events throughout the year, an annual company trip and our legendary Christmas parties. Interested? Apply today! We would love to have a conversation with you! Apply now, send us your CV and explain in your cover letter why you are excited about joining our mission for freedom in sustainable transportation. We are looking forward to your application! Fastned stands for equity and inclusion. description: Hi! We are AMBOSS and we are looking for a Financial Systems Architect to join our team, and shape the future of medical education with us! About AMBOSS AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering medical professionals globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.” Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique. Why Systems at AMBOSS? AMBOSS runs on a growing landscape of business systems: Workday as the ERP at the center, connected to Stripe, HubSpot, Pleo, Avalara, our banks, payroll and archiving. The Systems team, part of Data & Systems, makes this landscape develop as a whole: every problem solved in the system where it belongs, and processes that run smoothly from order to cash and from purchase to payment. Our expertise is platform-independent: accounting logic, process design, integration patterns and systems thinking. Working side by side with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, Data and IT, we support AMBOSS in pursuing its mission: empowering medical professionals worldwide to provide the best possible care. Why can this position be exciting for you? You are the technical owner of Workday Financials at AMBOSS: you take the tenant over from our implementation partner and run it. Some days that means a configuration fix before the close, other days the design of a new integration or the assessment of a new module. You are the expert and advisor for everything Workday. Our Business Systems Manager owns the roadmap, stakeholder coordination and partner management and works with you day to day. This is a senior individual contributor role: you build and own Workday the way a senior engineer owns a production system. It is not an administrator role with a ticket queue. Where we are Workday Financials goes live in November 2026 as our ERP for three entities in Germany, the US and Italy. Around twelve integrations connect it to the rest of the landscape, and they are the most demanding part of it. You join during hypercare and the first closes in Workday, with the first year-end close and statutory audit ahead. You will: Own the tenant technically. Configuration and business processes across record-to-report (General Ledger), procure-to-pay (Accounts Payable), order-to-cash (Accounts Receivable) and bank connectivity (Banking & Settlement), the security model and the financial data model. Take over from the implementation partner. Review, document and harden what was delivered, close the gaps and bring run responsibility in-house as early as possible after go-live. Where we still use consultants, you set the technical standard and review their work. Own the Workday side of every integration. Design and build the EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio integrations, web services and RaaS reports behind each interface and agree the interface contracts with our Data Platform engineers, who build and run the pipelines around the tenant. Advise Accounting and Finance. Translate requirements into system design, say clearly what Workday can and cannot do and advise where in the landscape a problem is best solved. Run it like a production system. Tier 2/3 support with root-cause fixes, testing discipline (unit, regression, UAT), the two Workday releases a year and a change log with configuration documentation. You enable the accounting stream leads who handle first-line questions. Build the reports, dashboards and calculated fields that Finance and leadership rely on, and make them self-serve where possible. Be the technical expert on expansions. HCM, treasury, automated VAT reporting and global payroll off DATEV: assess feasibility, design the solution and configure it. You bring: Workday Financials depth. 5+ years hands-on, including at least one full implementation and the post-go-live ownership of a tenant (hypercare, first closes, releases). Configuration expertise. Core modules (GL, AP, AR, Banking & Settlement), the business process framework, configurable security and the financial data model (FDM, worktags). Reporting. Custom and matrix reports, calculated fields and BIRT. Systems thinking. Experience connecting SaaS business systems (APIs, integration patterns) and the habit of thinking in end-to-end processes across tools. Accounting understanding. Chart of accounts, period close, reconciliations and audit requirements. Engineering mindset. Structured troubleshooting to the root cause, disciplined testing and documentation that others can use. Communication. Excellent English: precise with engineers, plain with finance colleagues. Nice to have: Hands-on experience with Workday integration tooling: EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio, web services, RaaS and XSLT Proficiency in German Workday Pro certification in Financials or Integrations Multi-entity, multi-currency or multi-GAAP experience (IFRS alongside local GAAP); experience with tax and e-invoicing platforms such as Avalara Accounting Center, Prism Analytics, Extend or Orchestrate A Workday consulting or CoE background A formal accounting background (degree, CPA or equivalent) or experience with internal controls and SOX in a Workday context You enjoy: Owning a system end to end. Taking over a freshly built tenant and knowing it better than anyone else in the company within months. Depth you can explain. You do the hard configuration and integration work yourself, and you explain the result to accountants and engineers in language each of them understands. Getting the details right where they matter. Financial systems punish sloppiness: a misconfigured business process or a broken integration shows up in the books. You can tell a load-bearing detail (audit trail, data integrity, reconciliations) from polish that can wait. Working like an engineer. You bring testing, documentation and versioned change into Workday and use modern tooling, including AI assistants, to move faster. When a release or a new module moves the ground, you question your own setup first. What success looks like after your first year: The tenant runs without the implementation partner. The integrations run reliably through every month-end and year-end close: data lands in Workday without manual intervention, and monitoring catches failures before Accounting does. The first year-end close and statutory audit in Workday are done with you answering the auditors' system questions, and two Workday releases are handled end to end. Accounting and Finance treat you as the expert and advisor for everything Workday: requirements are shaped with you from the start, and your call on how a process should run in the system is the one they act on. description: Ben jij een vooruitdenker die complexe data moeiteloos vertaalt naar glashelder advies? Waar een reguliere Fleet Manager sterk leunt op de dagelijkse operatie, sta jij als Senior Fleet Manager daarboven. Jouw werk draait niet om achteraf reageren, maar om proactief sturen. description: Werk jij graag in de logistiek en neem je makkelijk het voortouw? Dan zoeken wij jou. Je werkt actief mee op de werkvloer, begeleidt collega's en zorgt ervoor dat onze operatie veilig en efficiënt verloopt. Waar kom je te werken? Je komt te werken in ons depot in Joure. Samen met je collega's zorg je ervoor dat duizenden pakketten iedere dag op tijd worden verwerkt. Je werkt in een vast rooster met wisselende diensten: middagdienst: 11:00 tot 19:30 uur; nachtdienst: 02:00 tot 11:30 uur. Je bent bereid beide diensten te werken volgens een vooraf vastgesteld rooster. Wat ga je doen? Als senior logistiek medewerker begeleid je collega's op de werkvloer en ondersteun je de Teamleader Operations bij de dagelijkse operatie. Laden, lossen, sorteren en scannen van pakketten. Bewaken van de voortgang, kwaliteit en veiligheid. Collega's ondersteunen en begeleiden. Knelpunten signaleren en helpen oplossen. Aanspreekpunt zijn tijdens de dienst. De Teamleader Operations ondersteunen of vervangen. Meedenken over verbeteringen in het proces. Wat bieden we jou? Een salaris tussen € 2.501,82 en € 3.574,03 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring. Een functie 38,75 (1 fte) uur per week. Een gunstige ORT (onregelmatigheidstoeslag) 30% tussen 20:00 uur en 24:00 uur; 45% tussen 00:00 uur 06:00 uur; 50% op zaterdagen en zondagen; 100% op feestdagen; Opleidingskansen, ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en onbeperkt toegang tot onze Studyhub. 28 vakantiedagen (+ optie tot bijkoop) en reiskostenvergoeding. Veel extra’s, zoals een collectieve zorgverzekering en een aantrekkelijk pensioen. Wat neem je mee? Mbo werk- en denkniveau. Ervaring in logistiek, productie of operations. Ervaring met het begeleiden van collega's is een pre. Kennis van Excel. Je communiceert makkelijk en neemt initiatief. Je houdt overzicht en hebt oog voor mensen én processen. Over DPD Nederland Met 12 depots in Nederland en als onderdeel van Geopost, zijn we verbonden met een internationaal netwerk dat jaarlijks 1,2 miljard pakketten verwerkt. Achter deze indrukwekkende cijfers staan duizenden collega’s die zich elke dag inzetten, straks samen met jou. Onze cultuur is ondernemend, betrouwbaar en mensgericht. Wat ooit begon als een nuchter MKB-bedrijf leeft nog steeds voort: praktisch, sociaal en trots. We geloven in persoonlijk contact, samenwerking en zelf aanpakken. Uitdagingen gaan we niet uit de weg. Dat zit in ons DNA. We groeien hard, hebben grote ambities en jij hoort er straks écht bij. Samen maken we het verschil. Solliciteren Solliciteer eenvoudig via onderstaande sollicitatiebutton. Wij nemen zo snel mogelijk contact met je op. Zijn we allebei enthousiast? Dan zetten we samen de volgende stappen in de sollicitatieprocedure. Kennismaking: we leren elkaar beter kennen tijdens een eerste gesprek. Assessment: je maakt een online assessment thuis. Tweede gesprek: we bespreken de resultaten en gaan verder in op de functie. Aanbod: is er een match? Dan doen we je een aanbod. Vragen? Neem gerust contact op met onze corporate recruiter, Donne van der Wal via +31 6 29 989 532.
