description:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Consumer Products & Retail Transformation practice are looking for a Senior Manager/Director to join the team

Our Consumer Products & Retail practice is looking for an experienced Senior Manager or Director to join the team and help our clients deliver complex, business-critical transformation.

We are seeking a highly motivated consulting leader with a strong track record of designing and delivering large-scale transformation programmes within the consumer products and retail sectors. This could include experience across supply chain transformation, S&OP, planning and forecasting, ERP-enabled transformation, or operating model design and implementation.

This is a broad transformation leadership role rather than a position focused on a single functional specialism. The right person will combine strong consulting and programme leadership capabilities with the commercial confidence to lead client relationships, manage complex engagements, and identify opportunities to deepen and grow existing accounts.

Candidates may have built their career entirely within consulting or combined consulting with relevant industry experience. However, substantial consulting experience and a clear understanding of how to lead clients through complex transformation are essential.

What we are looking for

You will be a pragmatic transformation leader who is comfortable moving between strategic thinking and the realities of implementation. You will understand what it takes to mobilise and deliver complex programmes, engage senior client stakeholders, and create alignment across business and technology teams.

You do not need to be a pure business development or new-logo origination specialist. However, you must be comfortable owning senior client relationships, leading the day-to-day development of accounts, and identifying opportunities to broaden our impact with existing clients.

You will also bring enough depth in consumer products or retail to understand the commercial and operational context in which clients are transforming, while retaining the breadth to work across different types of transformation challenge.

What you will be doing

  • Lead complex transformation engagements for consumer products and retail clients, taking responsibility for successful delivery from initial design through to implementation.
  • Help clients shape and deliver transformation across areas such as supply chain, S&OP, business planning, forecasting, ERP implementation, and operating model effectiveness.
  • Translate strategic objectives into practical transformation roadmaps, delivery plans, governance structures, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Lead the day-to-day management of major client accounts and engagements, building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders.
  • Act as a confident and credible account leader who can strengthen client relationships, identify emerging needs, and grow existing accounts.
  • Oversee complex programmes involving multiple workstreams, business functions, technology platforms, geographies, and stakeholder groups.
  • Work across business and technology teams to ensure that transformation programmes deliver sustainable operational improvements rather than standalone systems or process changes.
  • Advise clients on the organisational, process, capability, data, and technology changes required to deliver successful transformation.
  • Provide clear leadership to multidisciplinary project teams, creating an environment in which consultants can perform effectively and develop their capabilities.
  • Manage programme risks, dependencies, budgets, resources, governance, and senior stakeholder expectations.
  • Support business development activity through proposal development, solution design, client presentations, and the expansion of existing relationships.
  • Contribute to the continued development of our Consumer Products & Retail practice, including its propositions, delivery capabilities, market profile, and people.

Your skills and experience

  • Significant experience within consulting, with a strong track record of leading complex transformation engagements for consumer products or retail clients.
  • Experience operating at Senior Manager, Director, or an equivalent level within a recognised consulting organisation.
  • Demonstrable expertise in one or more of the following areas:
    • Supply chain transformation
    • Sales and operations planning, or S&OP
    • Demand, supply, or integrated business planning
    • Forecasting and planning transformation
    • ERP-enabled business transformation
    • Operating model design and implementation
    • Complex programme leadership
  • Experience leading major transformation programmes from strategy and design through to implementation and business adoption.
  • A strong understanding of how business processes, operating models, data, technology, organisation design, and change management come together within a successful transformation.
  • Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary consulting teams and manage multiple workstreams within complex client environments.
  • Strong client engagement and account management skills, with the confidence to work with senior client stakeholders and manage important day-to-day relationships.
  • Evidence of growing or expanding existing client accounts by identifying additional client needs and converting them into relevant opportunities.
  • Strong commercial judgement, including experience managing engagement economics, delivery quality, scope, risk, and client expectations.
  • The ability to communicate complex transformation topics clearly and credibly to both business and technology stakeholders.
  • Excellent problem-solving, facilitation, influencing, and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • A collaborative leadership style and a strong commitment to coaching and developing consulting talent.
  • Industry experience gained before, during, or after a consulting career would be valuable, but candidates must bring substantial and current consulting capability.

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

Join us

All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As a Senior People Tech Specialist, you will be responsible for enhancing the user experience within the Workday platform. This responsibility includes Workday configuration, conducting thorough Workday testing, sharing insights and providing end-user support for Workday-related inquiries.

You will join our dynamic People Tech team, which primarily manages the Workday - Human Capital Management (HCM) system. Reporting to the People Tech Manager, you will collaborate with other People Tech team members. Our team is accountable for configuring Workday, adopting new functionalities, integrating with other systems, and tailoring the system to meet the company's needs. We strive to make Workday a user-friendly, self-service tool that caters to our organization's specific requirements.

This is a fixed-term position approximately 2 years.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Troubleshoot Workday technical problems and deficiencies in a timely manner
  • Audit for data integrity, accuracy and timeliness
  • Advocate for the use of technology and automation across people processes
  • Do unit testing and create test plans, coordinate end-to-end testing until resolution.
  • Develop system documentation
  • Drive / support implementation of additional Workday modules
  • Provide end user support on more complex issues
  • Contribute to interdependent HR wide projects
  • Suggest and implement Workday enhancements, process improvements
  • Perform Workday Release testing and adopt improvements
  • Partner with HR and other stakeholders
  • Support other projects and ad hoc requests

About you 

  • Solid experience with Workday configuration within Compensation and Advanced Compensation functional areas.
  • Confidence with Workday Security, Business Processes, Reporting, Calculated Fields, Condition Rules, EIBs, Custom Organization hierarchies.
  • Advanced Excel / Gsheet skills
  • Experienced in updating and maintaining project plans
  • High attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Excellent at communicating in spoken and written English
  • Capability of handling confidential information discreetly and demonstrate a strong work ethic.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

€63.000—€85.200 EUR

About Acadia Pharmaceuticals
 
Acadia is committed to turning scientific promise into meaningful innovation that makes the difference for underserved neurological and rare disease communities around the world. Our commercial portfolio includes the first and only FDA-approved treatments for Parkinson’s disease psychosis and Rett syndrome. We are developing the next wave of therapeutic advancements with a robust and diverse pipeline that includes mid- to late-stage programs in Alzheimer’s disease psychosis and Lewy body dementia psychosis, along with earlier-stage programs that address other underserved patient needs. At Acadia, we’re here to be their difference.

Position Summary

The Sr. Medical Director, Germany will lead the development and execution of the local medical affairs strategy together with the field Medical Science Liaisons (MSLs) and in line with the European Medical Affairs strategy and the local country strategy for RETT syndrome including the integrated medical plans with full medical budget ownership and responsibility. Responsibilities will include building and maintaining external stakeholder relationships and collaborations, as well as continuing to position Acadia as a thought leader and valued partner with patient advocacy groups (PAG) and medical/scientific RETT community in Germany. This individual will be responsible for the effectiveness and compliance of scientific exchange conducted to meet the needs of clinicians, patient advocates, and other key external and internal stakeholders.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Provide scientific and medical leadership, including development of strategic country medical affairs (post-launch) plans, identifying specific unmet medical needs, and data gaps.
  • Leading the local medical affairs team.
  • Ensure strong medical/scientific leadership in coordination and participation in country MRC/MLR procedures.
  • Establish appropriate strategic partnerships with Centers of Excellence, KOLs, and PAGs, in areas of scientific interest.
  • Ensure aligned and close cross-functional collaboration, with country GM, Market Access, other relevant country and international staff to optimally manage relationships and ensure alignment and effective execution of the German medical strategy.
  • Coordinate and ensure operational medical excellence, in collaboration with EU medical teams and aligned with country strategy, to capture and track key medical tactics and medical (post-launch) activities in Germany.
  • Provide medical expertise and editorial support in data dissemination at conferences and in medical journals, as appropriate.
  • Involvement with key HCPs in the exchange of scientific and medical information including Advisory Boards and presentations at national meetings and conferences.
  • Develop and maintain, together with MSLs, close professional relationships with KOLs and emerging scientific leaders in the community.
  • Oversee gathering and reporting field medical insights through existing Veeva CRM system and in line with company rules and requirements.
  • Oversee and communicate to cross-functional stakeholders the insights the MSL team gains about competitive landscape, unmet needs of physicians and advocacy groups. Develops potential actionable plans to address these local insights.
  • Manages publication activities, including review and approval of abstracts and manuscripts, local publication strategy and real-world evidence development and compliant collaboration with authors, as needed.

Education/Experience/Skills

  • MD highly preferred; PhD, PharmD, or an equivalent qualification may also be considered.
  • 15+ years of Medical Affairs leadership experience in the biopharmaceutical industry in Germany or the DACH region; broader regional experience is advantageous.
  • Prior team-management experience is required.
  • Substantial rare-disease—preferably neurological—experience in Germany and/or the DACH region.
  • Extensive knowledge of the German healthcare system and applicable national rules and regulations.
  • Significant experience coordinating and participating in national MLR/MRC procedures.
  • Experience engaging with rare-disease patient advocacy groups is highly preferred.

Key Skills

  • Extensive knowledge to critically appraise studies and clinical evidence to allow engagement on higher scientific level with HCPs.
  • In depth understanding of compliance and regulatory requirements, including extensive personal experience and expertise with MRC/MLR procedures, for pharmaceutical Medical Affairs, R&D and Commercial activities in Germany.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and presentation skills, and experience in the delivery of scientific presentations.
  • Agile, independent and proactive working style.
  • Personal sense of purpose, confidence, and stand fest in challenging situations.
  • Ability to build strong cross-functional and cross-company relationships.
  • Ability to collaborate and share information to contribute to the planning process and execute the agreed local Medical (pre)launch plan, together with MSL team, and in line with Regional Medical Affairs strategy.
  • Fluency in German at native or near-native level and strong English proficiency are required, with the ability to communicate complex details clearly.
  • Ability to travel both locally and internationally is required.

This is a role for a strong marketer and an exceptional writer. You can take a complex capability, a shifting market, or a fuzzy customer problem and shape it into a sharp point of view, a persuasive narrative, and practical tools that sellers and customers actually use. You will work closely with Product, Sales, Marketing & Communications, subject-matter experts, and GTM Solutions & Readiness teams to make the story land in the market. description:
We are seeking a Staff Applied AI Researcher to join a fast-growing team building an agent-native search platform - the web access layer for AI systems.

You can think of this as Google search, but for AI agents: a system designed for machines, not humans. We are building agentic search, where AI systems actively plan, retrieve, evaluate, and refine information rather than simply returning results. As AI becomes the primary interface to the web, this layer will replace the role of traditional search engines.

We are designing these systems to search and reason over web data in real time, under strict latency and reliability constraints. This means solving retrieval, ranking and passage extraction under entirely new access patterns and at significant scale, with systems operating over constantly changing, unstructured data and serving tens of thousands of production workloads 24/7.

This role comes with ownership over key parts of our applied AI research direction and system design, with a strong expectation of defining new approaches and shipping measurable impact in production. In the first year, you will own a specific part of the search stack, e.g. ranking or iterative retrieval.

What you'll work on:

  • Designing an agent-native search system that handles everything from low-latency single-hop search to complex deep search tasks requiring iterative planning, querying, refinement and reasoning.

  • Training ranking and retrieval models optimized for agent-driven workflows under real world constraints

  • Bringing the latest advances from the research community to our search stack and ship it to production.

Your responsibilities:

  • Drive applied research and technical direction across retrieval and ranking systems

  • Design and evolve multi-stage retrieval architectures (query understanding, rewriting, retrieval, reranking and iterative retrieval)

  • Lead experimentation on modern retrieval approaches (embedding research, sparse and hybrid retrieval, reranking, context compression) and bring them into production

  • Develop methods for grounding LLMs in real-time web data at scale, using trust, quality and freshness signals to surface reliable sources

  • Partner with the evaluation team to define new metrics for agentic systems, where correctness is not reducible to clicks

  • Analyze trade-offs across relevance, latency, and cost, and work closely with engineering to deploy systems that operate at web scale

  • Mentor researchers and engineers and help raise the technical bar of the team

Must haves:

  • 8+ years of experience in applied AI, ML, or software engineering

  • Proven track record of shipping ML or AI systems to production at scale

  • Deep experience with search, retrieval, ranking or building RAG-based assistants

  • Strong understanding of modern deep learning, especially transformers and embeddings

  • Experience with LLM-integrated or knowledge-intensive systems

  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks and metrics for ML systems

  • Strong programming skills in Python

  • Top-tier publications (ICLR, ICML, NeurIPS, AAAI, EMNLP, ACL)

  • Ability to operate in a fast-moving, product-driven environment with high ownership and autonomy

Nice to haves

  • Background in agentic AI systems (agents, tool use, autonomous workflows)

  • Experience with RL post-training of LLMs or VLMs

description: Projet porté par : Marwa Trabelsi - IMT Mines Albi Centre Génie Industriel (CGI) Partenaires IMT impliqués : Telecom Sud Paris, Département Electronique et Physique, Laboratoire Services répartis, Architectures, Modélisation, Validation, Administration des Réseaux (SAMOVAR): Nel Samama Mines Saint-Etienne : Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS), Marius Huguet Sujet proposé (5-6 mois à partir de Février): Acronyme : HOPAL : Hospital Process Automatic Learning Titre long : Construction automatique de modèles de processus hospitaliers multi-flux par grands modèles de langage (LLM) Description du projet : L’étude du processus de prise en charge aux urgences est essentielle pour comprendre et résoudre le problème croissant de surcharge, qui touche de nombreux pays. Cette surcharge, souvent liée à un déséquilibre entre la demande de soins et les ressources disponibles, a des conséquences graves : retards de traitement, allongement des temps de triage, et même une augmentation de la mortalité. Elle révèle aussi des défis systémiques, comme l’accès difficile aux soins primaires, qui poussent les patients vers les urgences. Optimiser l’utilisation des ressources humaines et matérielles permet non seulement de réduire les files d’attente, mais aussi d’améliorer la qualité des soins et l’efficacité globale du système. Enfin, analyser ces processus aide à identifier des solutions durables, comme une meilleure organisation ou une réallocation ciblée des moyens. Ces processus laissent des traces numériques dans le système d'information hospitalier (SIH), mais leur modélisation reste aujourd'hui largement manuelle, coûteuse et rapidement obsolète. Le process mining permet de découvrir des modèles de processus à partir de ces traces. Les techniques classiques de découverte atteignent toutefois leurs limites face à des logs hétérogènes, bruités et multi-flux. Les grands modèles de langage (LLM) ouvrent une voie nouvelle : générer automatiquement des modèles de processus (BPMN, graphes de processus) directement à partir de traces organisationnelles, sans intervention humaine, et en produire une lecture compréhensible par les acteurs de terrain. Par ailleurs, des travaux menés au CGI ont démontré la faisabilité de la prédiction de parcours patients par LLM. La question scientifique au cœur de ce stage est l'articulation de ces deux briques : comment relier la prédiction de parcours à la construction automatique de modèles, pour passer de modèles rétrospectifs (ce qui s'est passé) à des modèles prospectifs (ce qui va se passer) ? Ce projet s’inscrit dans une dynamique inter-écoles IMT autour de l’IA explicable pour la santé publique. Les équipes CGI, CIS et SAMOVAR collaborent déjà via le projet TRACKING (Carnot M.I.N.E.S – CARINGS), avec des travaux sur la géolocalisation indoor au sein des urgences de l’Hôpital Le Corbusier de Firminy. Cette synergie s’est prolongée par un stage M2 en 2025, financé par le Fonds d’amorçage Santé, dédié au prototypage d’une application mobile de localisation indoor/outdoor des patients. Une thèse INTERCARNOT a été lancé dans la continuité avec la validation des deux instituts Carnot (M.I.N.E.S et TSN) et va démarrer en Octobre 2026. Objectif du stage L'objectif est de concevoir et prototyper un pipeline dans lequel un même module de construction automatique de modèles par LLM est alimenté par deux sources : Branche A (rétrospective) : les logs SIH réels, normalisés en event logs, produisent des modèles as-is des processus observés ; Branche B (prospective) : dans la suite des travaux réalisés, les parcours prédits par LLM sont sérialisés au même format de traces (activité, timestamp, ressource) via un adaptateur, et produisent des modèles to-be des processus à venir. La comparaison des modèles as-is et to-be permet la détection d'écarts, l'anticipation des goulots d'étranglement et le support à la décision explicable, jusqu'à la simulation contrefactuelle (perturber les prédictions, reconstruire le modèle, observer l'impact). Profil recherché Formation : M2 ou dernière année d'école d'ingénieur en informatique, science des données, IA ou génie industriel ; Compétences techniques : Python indispensable ; une expérience des LLM (fine-tuning, prompting, API) et/ou du process mining (pm4py) est un atout fort ; Qualités : rigueur scientifique, autonomie, goût pour le travail avec des données réelles imparfaites, intérêt pour le domaine hospitalier. Le stockage d’énergie thermochimique stocke la chaleur sous forme d’énergie chimique, grâce à des réactions solide-gaz réversibles. Les hydrates de sels inorganiques absorbent de la chaleur lors de leur déshydratation et la restituent lors de leur réhydratation, ce qui en fait des matériaux candidats pour le stockage de chaleur. Leur performance en cyclage dépend des structures cristallines traversées entre les états d’hydratation, dont le volume de maille et la symétrie peuvent différer fortement. Les caractérisations ex situ, avant et après réaction, ne donnent accès qu’aux états extrêmes, pas au chemin de transformation. Et vous, prêt·e à innover à nos côtés ? 🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous La production de béton est responsable d'environ 8 % des émissions mondiales de CO2. Ces émissions sont principalement liées à la combustion et à la décarbonatation du calcaire nécessaire à la production du ciment Portland conventionnel. Les liants à base de magnésie (MgO) sont étudiés comme alternatives potentielles aux ciments conventionnels, avec une empreinte carbone réduite. Le magnésium nécessaire à leur production pourrait être extrait de roches non carbonatées ou de saumures riches en magnésium. Ces ressources constituent des sources alternatives de matières premières et pourraient permettre d'éviter les émissions de CO2 liées à la décarbonatation du calcaire. Cependant, ces liants alternatifs sont encore en cours de développement et leurs mécanismes d'hydratation, leur composition et leurs propriétés mécaniques doivent être mieux compris. En particulier, la nature et la réactivité de la source de magnésium, ainsi que les conditions de formulation et de préparation, peuvent influencer la microstructure et les performances mécaniques du matériau obtenu. L'objectif de ce stage est d'étudier différentes sources de magnésium et d'évaluer leur potentiel pour le développement de liants de type MgO-SiO2 présentant de bonnes propriétés mécaniques et un impact environnemental réduit. Plusieurs formulations de liants seront préparées et étudiées en faisant varier la source de magnésium et différents paramètres de formulation. Les matériaux obtenus seront caractérisés à l'aide de techniques complémentaires afin d'évaluer leur composition chimique, les phases formées lors de l'hydratation, leur microstructure, leur porosité et leurs propriétés mécaniques. description: L’Agence du Numérique en Santé (ANS) accompagne la transformation numérique du système de santé en France. Elle œuvre, aux côtés de ses partenaires institutionnels et professionnels, à garantir la confiance dans le numérique en santé, à sécuriser les échanges de données et à promouvoir des outils au service de la qualité des soins et du pilotage du système de santé. Vous rejoindrez le Centre de Services Data de la Direction des opérations (DOPS). Cette équipe transverse accompagne les programmes métiers de l’ANS dans la valorisation des données, pilote la plateforme data et l’Observatoire de la e-Santé et contribue à la diffusion de pratiques fiables de traitement et d’exploitation des données. Fiabiliser l’accès aux données et la documentation Revoir et enrichir les documents existants, notamment le catalogue de données, et créer la documentation manquante. description: About Doit We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. The Role Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Strategy & Operations Lead of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area. You will be the first senior hire in Lithuania. You will own the regulatory relationship, the build of the team, the partner network and the launch. You will sit on the management board and lead the business day to day. We’re looking for a generalist who learns quickly, thinks deeply, and enjoys solving difficult problems in a fast-moving, regulated environment. What You’ll Own Own the relationship with the Bank of Lithuania and other regulators. Build the Vilnius team, including compliance, operations and control functions. Select and negotiate with execution, custody, fund and banking partners. Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget. Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA. Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements. Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth. Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes. What We’re Looking For Generalist background in consulting, investment banking, start-ups, private equity or venture capital. Experience building or scaling a business, ideally in financial services or fintech. Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment. Ability to learn regulation quickly and work credibly with regulators. Strong ownership and execution skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with boards, regulators, partners and teams. Comfortable working across product, operations, finance and compliance. A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a senior manager. Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania. Curious, resourceful, and driven to build. Nice to Have Lithuanian language ability. An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania. Experience with MiFID II, brokerage, wealth management or fund distribution. Experience building or running a regulated financial business in the EU. This Role Is Not For People who only want to attend meetings. Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally. Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines. People who avoid messy cross-functional problems. People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions. People who see regulation as someone else’s problem. Location This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week. You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. description: GRESB is the global sustainability intelligence standard for real assets. For over 15 years, real estate and infrastructure managers have reported to us, building a dataset of 150,000+ assets across more than 2,000 portfolios. Together with Asset Impact, which tracks emissions for over 300,000 physical assets and 77,000 companies, we’re turning that data into decision-grade intelligence for investors, lenders, index providers and regulators. We’re building a new Client & Data Intelligence organization to showcase the value of the data to investors and develop new use cases within the ecosystem. It brings sales, product and data teams together under one leader, the Chief Client & Data Intelligence Officer. This role is the person who makes that organization run. The role is based out of Amsterdam. The Role You’ll work directly with the Chief Client & Data Intelligence Officer as the strategist and operator at the center of a newly formed team. Your job is to keep decisions moving, teams connected and priority work getting finished, so the leadership team can focus on clients and growth. It’s a role for someone who can shape a problem and then see it through. One week you might be building the business case for a new data product; the next you’re tightening the sales pipeline, preparing a board update and unblocking a delivery issue between product and engineering. You’ll move between sales enablement, product and data operations, and you’ll be trusted to run several projects at once without dropping any of them. You’ll see the whole business, from client conversations to product decisions to the CEO’s agenda, and you’ll have influence over how a new organization works. What you will do Strategy and priority projects Lead the organization’s highest-priority initiatives end to end, for example pricing, our investor program, entry into new markets and maturing the data strategy Frame the problem, build the analysis, align stakeholders and drive the work through to a decision and implementation Bring a recommendation, not just options Operating rhythm and decision-making Run the team’s operating cadence: weekly deal desk, fortnightly product council and monthly business review Own the decision log, so it’s always clear what was decided, by whom and what happens next Spot blockers between sales, product and data teams early and clear them Commercial operations and sales enablement Own pricing and support deal structuring with the sales team Keep pipeline and ARR reporting accurate and trusted, with one view across GRESB Work with sales and product to make sure the team has what it needs to showcase the value of the data products Reporting and communication Build and run the monthly CEO dashboard and KPI reporting Prepare senior leadership, board and client materials that are clear, concise and decision-ready Act as the Chief Client & Data Intelligence Officer’s point of contact when they’re away What success looks like In your first six months The operating rhythm is running and people rely on it The decision log is live and used There’s one trusted ARR view across GRESB data products By the end of your first year At least two priority projects have been taken from problem to implemented decision Leadership and board reporting runs on a predictable monthly cycle with little rework Sales, product and data teams describe fewer handoff issues, and escalations get resolved faster Requirements Around 6–10 years of experience A grounding in top-tier management consulting or Big Four advisory, in strategy, sustainability, data or technology Ideally, spent time at a sustainability data, ESG ratings, real asset or financial data business Strong business acumen and ability to work well in a cross-functional, global environment. Experience implementing AI or advanced analytics solutions within a commercial or sales environment. Proficiency in CRM, data analytics, and visualization tools. A working understanding of how data products are packaged, priced and sold How you work You think in structure: you can break down an ambiguous problem, find what matters and build a clear path forward You finish things. You run several projects at once and see each one through to the end You’re organized, detail-oriented and work well in systems You write and present clearly, whether it’s a one-page update or a board deck You get things done without formal authority, by earning trust across sales, product and engineering You’re comfortable moving between the big picture and the detail in the same day Benefits Involvement in a fast growing international data-driven company Opportunity to work with a highly talented and committed team in a supportive environment with strong camaraderie Annual leave of 25 days per calendar year 2 volunteering days off per year Company pension plan Free public transport to and from the Amsterdam office Free and healthy office lunch catered daily Annual professional development budget Home office budget About GRESB GRESB is the global sustainability intelligence standard for real assets. We transform sustainability data into decision-grade intelligence that drives capital allocation and asset improvement. Our vision: An investment industry that plays a central role in creating a sustainable world. Our mission: To provide financial markets with actionable sustainability insights, data, and benchmarks. More than 100 global institutional and financial investors rely on GRESB to help guide their investment decisions, mitigating risk, improving portfolio quality, and driving long-term financial success. The GRESB team is an energetic group of more than 100 individuals from diverse backgrounds with experience spanning sustainability, data science, software development, real estate, infrastructure, and the capital markets. Most of us work out of our head office in Amsterdam or one of our satellite offices in London, Paris, Berlin, Boston, Singapore, or Sydney. We’re passionate about tackling the sustainability challenge by providing the insights that will power the markets of the future and enable investors to allocate the world’s capital in a more responsible way. GRESB is a portfolio company of BeyondNetZero, General Atlantic's climate investing platform. About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Baringa is looking for talented 2027 Summer Interns to join our Solutions & AI Lab team.

Our Internship

Our eight week Summer Internship Programme is designed to give you hands-on experience, meaningful responsibility, and a true insight into life at Baringa. Over the course of the programme, you’ll work alongside experienced consultants and specialists on real projects, develop valuable skills through tailored learning opportunities, and build connections across the business. Whether you’re exploring your career options or looking to kick-start your professional journey, our internship offers a supportive environment where you can learn, grow, and make an impact.

What's in it for you?

Well, it’s up to you. Baringa is what you make it.

description: wo-afstudeerstage/praktijkstage, vanaf februari 2027 Ben jij die nieuwsgierige onderzoeker die energie krijgt van data, duurzaamheid en nieuwe inzichten? Wil jij een inhoudelijke bijdrage leveren aan de statistieken van het CBS? Dit is jouw uitdaging Het kabinet wil dat Nederland in 2050 volledig circulair is. Om te kunnen volgen of we die doelstelling halen, is betrouwbare informatie nodig over onder andere afval en emissies naar water. Het CBS verzamelt en publiceert deze gegevens voor bedrijven. Daarbij maken we vooral gebruik van gegevens uit het elektronisch Milieujaarverslag (e-MJV), aangevuld met enquêtes. Naast de hoeveelheid afval en wateremissies brengen we ook de milieukosten van bedrijven in kaart, bijvoorbeeld de kosten voor afvalverwerking en voor het lozen van afvalwater. Hiervoor wordt nu een aparte enquête gebruikt. Maar is dat eigenlijk wel nodig? Tijdens je stage onderzoek je of we de milieukosten voor afval en wateremissies kunnen berekenen met gegevens die al beschikbaar zijn. Je combineert bijvoorbeeld gegevens over de hoeveelheid afval en geloosd water met bestaande indicatoren, zoals gemiddelde kosten per ton afval en sectorspecifieke kosten per kubieke meter geloosd water. Je gaat onder andere: bestaande data en indicatoren analyseren en beoordelen op bruikbaarheid; onderzoeken welke methode het meest geschikt is om de milieukosten te schatten; een berekening of model ontwikkelen waarmee de kosten kunnen worden afgeleid; de uitkomsten vergelijken met de beschikbare gegevens uit de huidige enquête; onderzoeken hoe betrouwbaar en bruikbaar de schattingen zijn; je bevindingen vertalen naar een concreet advies voor het CBS. Met jouw onderzoek willen we bepalen of we meer uit bestaande data kunnen halen en minder hoeven uit te vragen bij bedrijven. Als blijkt dat de milieukosten betrouwbaar kunnen worden berekend, kunnen de uitkomsten bovendien worden gebruikt om de bestaande afval- en waterstatistieken te controleren. In het meest gunstige scenario kan de aparte enquête naar milieukosten gedeeltelijk of helemaal vervallen. Dat betekent minder administratieve lasten voor bedrijven, efficiënter gebruik van beschikbare data en mogelijk betrouwbaardere statistieken. Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag We verwelkomen je binnen de sector Leefomgeving bij team Milieu. Met 20 gedreven professionals werken we aan milieu gerelateerde statistieken en doen we onderzoek naar actuele thema’s zoals klimaat(verandering) en circulaire economie. We werken nauw samen met andere teams binnen het CBS. We werken hard aan het continu verbeteren van onze statistieken en de cijfers beschikbaar te stellen voor het publiek. Voorbeelden van recente publicaties uit ons team zijn: Bedrijven investeerden in 2024 minder in milieu | CBS Bijna 2 procent meer bedrijfs- en industrieafval in 2021 | CBS Milieukosten en -investeringen van bedrijven | CBS Dit breng jij mee Je volgt een wo-opleiding milieukunde, economie, technische bestuurskunde, data science of een aanverwante opleiding. Je hebt affiniteit met het onderwerp circulaire economie. Je bent analytisch sterk en kunt complexe vraagstukken gestructureerd onderzoeken en vertalen naar heldere inzichten. Je kunt goed programmeren in R. Je bent sociaal en communicatief vaardig en kunt je ideeën en bevindingen helder overbrengen aan verschillende gesprekspartners. Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk. Dit kun je van ons verwachten Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je: jouw competenties in kwantitatieve data-analyse versterkt door gebruik te maken van milieustatistieken en economische databronnen; jouw onderzoeksvaardigheden aanscherpt op het gebied van de circulaire economie en levenscyclusanalyse; jouw programmeervaardigheden in R verder ontwikkelt; ervaring opdoet met het interpreteren van verschillende datasets om betrouwbare profielen op te stellen. Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week). Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken. Dit zijn onze voorwaarden Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken. Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

The role places a strong emphasis on automation, performance optimization, and operational excellence. You will be expected to innovate and scale SAP solutions and applications, ensuring their seamless integration and high availability across the enterprise. Additionally, as a platform ranger, you should demonstrate proficiency with the latest technologies and tools, such as generative AI, and actively disseminate this expertise throughout all SAP solutions. Work with multitenant SaaS architectures ensuring secure tenant isolation and hyperscaler-agnostic deployments. Employ chunking, embedding generation, and vector store management to enable efficient information retrieval and contextualization. Optimize orchestration pipelines to handle prompt templating, query rewriting, and fusion techniques (e.g., Reciprocal Rank Fusion) for enhanced retrieval precision. Lead end-to-end lifecycle of GenAI projects—from model integration and fine-tuning in AI Core to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Collaborate and manage cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact solutions on time and within scope. Map business requirements to AI-powered solution architectures. Mentor and upskill team members through knowledge-sharing sessions and best practice frameworks. Track and report project progress, ensuring strategic alignment with business objectives. Experience with schema-based output parsing, prompt templating, and prompt-engineering best practices & AI evaluation frameworks. Familiarity with content filtering, data masking, and AI governance / compliance frameworks in enterprise environments. Working knowledge of CAP (Cloud Application Programming model) and SAP Extension Suite for integrating GenAI into enterprise apps. Understanding of vector stores, vector search, and semantic search APIs in HANA Cloud. Exposure to multi-tenant SaaS architecture, hyperscaler-agnostic deployments, and MLOps pipelines for AI solutions. Have handled deployment of large-scale SAP applications, infrastructure, data, integrations, and related systems. Expertise in application design principles, cloud-native development, and integration within SAP ecosystem. Familiarity with integration techniques and tools within the SAP ecosystem. Strong understanding of application design principles and methodologies. Experience in Agentic development with A2A protocol with MCP server. Working knowledge of RDF, SPARQL, OWL or equivalent graph technologies. Awareness of Responsible AI principles: transparency, explainability, fairness, and privacy. Excellent analytical, communication, and presentation abilities. Demonstrated experience in managing AI-centric innovation programs. SAP Certified Associate - Positioning SAP Business AI Solutions as part of SAP Business Suite Roles & Responsibilities: - Lead AI-driven solution design and delivery using Generative and Agentic AI to solve complex business problems, automate processes, and integrate intelligent insights into enterprise operations for measurable impact. - Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for SAP BTP and GenAI solutions. - Building technical architecture design aligning with SAP and enterprise standards. - Architect and implement Generative AI pipelines on SAP BTP, leveraging SAP AI Core, Generative AI Hub, and SAP HANA Cloud (Vector Engine + Knowledge Graph Engine). - Build Knowledge Graphs and ontologies to model enterprise domains and link contextual data for reasoning and relationship-aware GenAI applications. - Develop LangChain / LangGraph-based orchestration pipelines for prompt templating, retrieval, generation, and post-processing. - Implement data-masking, content filtering, and schema-based output parsing to ensure compliance, privacy, and structured response formats. - Collaborate with development teams using SAP Cloud Application Programming (CAP) model to embed AI capabilities into cloud-native applications. - Work with multitenant SaaS architectures ensuring secure tenant isolation and hyperscaler-agnostic deployments. - Employ chunking, embedding generation, and vector store management to enable efficient information retrieval and contextualization. - Optimize orchestration pipelines to handle prompt templating, query rewriting, and fusion techniques (e.g., Reciprocal Rank Fusion) for enhanced retrieval precision. - Lead end-to-end lifecycle of GenAI projects—from model integration and fine-tuning in AI Core to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. - Collaborate and manage cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact solutions on time and within scope. - Map business requirements to AI-powered solution architectures. - Mentor and upskill team members through knowledge-sharing sessions and best practice frameworks. - Ensure solution scalability, performance, and responsible AI usage principles are embedded throughout the development lifecycle. - Track and report project progress, ensuring strategic alignment with business objectives. Professional & Technical Skills: - Deep understanding of SAP BTP services especially AI Core, Generative AI Hub, HANA Cloud (Vector Engine and Knowledge Graph Engine). - Expertise with Large Language Models, Foundation Models, and LLM Orchestration Frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or Semantic Kernel. - Hands-on experience designing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines with embedding, chunking, and vector similarity search. - Proficiency in Knowledge Graph design, GraphRAG, and ontology modelling using SAP HANA Cloud or graph databases. - Strong grasp of data grounding, semantic enrichment, and enterprise contextualization. - Experience with schema-based output parsing, prompt templating, and prompt-engineering best practices & AI evaluation frameworks. - Familiarity with content filtering, data masking, and AI governance / compliance frameworks in enterprise environments. - Working knowledge of CAP (Cloud Application Programming model) and SAP Extension Suite for integrating GenAI into enterprise apps. - Understanding of vector stores, vector search, and semantic search APIs in HANA Cloud. - Exposure to multi-tenant SaaS architecture, hyperscaler-agnostic deployments, and MLOps pipelines for AI solutions. - Have handled deployment of large-scale SAP applications, infrastructure, data, integrations, and related systems. - Expertise in application design principles, cloud-native development, and integration within SAP ecosystem. - Familiarity with integration techniques and tools within the SAP ecosystem. - Strong understanding of application design principles and methodologies. - Ability to align AI capabilities with business objectives while ensuring scalability, responsible use, and tangible value realization. - Ability to analyze and optimize application performance. title: Data Modeler

description: Project Role : Data Modeler Project Role Description : Work with key business representatives, data owners, end users, application designers and data architects to model current and new data. Must have skills : Graph Databases Good to have skills : Neo4j Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: As a Data Modeler, a typical day involves engaging closely with various stakeholders including business representatives, data owners, end users, application designers, and data architects. The role focuses on understanding existing data structures and designing new data models that align with business needs and technical requirements. This position requires continuous collaboration to ensure that data models are accurate, efficient, and scalable, supporting both current and future organizational objectives. The Data Modeler plays a vital role in bridging the gap between business goals and technical implementation through thoughtful data design and analysis. Roles & Responsibilities: -Design and develop formal ontologies, taxonomies, and controlled vocabularies using OWL, RDFS, and SKOS. - Elicit and model domain knowledge through structured interviews and workshops with subject-matter experts. - Integrate ontologies with knowledge graph infrastructure (e.g. Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Stardog) and validate consistency using reasoners such as HermiT or Pellet. - Write and maintain SPARQL queries and SHACL/ShEx constraints to validate data conformance. - Align internal models with industry standards and open standards such as schema.org, Dublin Core, or domain-specific vocabularies. - Establish versioning, documentation, and governance practices for ontology lifecycle management. - Support downstream AI/ML teams by providing semantically enriched data for entity resolution, recommendation, and question-answering systems. - Required qualifications - Degree in computer science, information science, linguistics, or a related field (or equivalent experience) Hands-on experience with OWL 2, RDF, RDFS, and SKOS - Proficiency with Prot g or equivalent ontology authoring tools - Strong understanding of description logics and formal semantics - Scripting ability in Python for ontology processing and ETL tasks - Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform. - Responsible for team decisions. - Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions. - Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams. - Lead efforts to align data modeling practices with organizational standards and best practices. - Facilitate communication between technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure clarity and shared understanding. - Mentor junior team members to support their professional growth and enhance team capabilities. Professional & Technical Skills: - Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Graph Databases. - Good To Have Skills: Experience with Neo4j. - Strong knowledge of data modeling concepts and methodologies specific to graph database technologies. - Ability to design and optimize complex data models that support efficient querying and data retrieval. - Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical data solutions. - Familiarity with data integration and data governance principles to maintain data quality and consistency. Additional Information: - The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Graph Databases. - This position is based at our Bhubaneswar office. Education: - A 15 years full time education is required. 15 years full time education About Accenture Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. title: Data Modeler

description: Project Role : Data Management Practitioner Project Role Description : Maintain the quality and compliance of an organizations data assets. Design and implement data strategies, ensuring data integrity and enforcing governance policies. Establish protocols to handle data, safeguard sensitive information, and optimize data usage within the organization. Design and advise on data quality rules and set up effective data compliance policies. Must have skills : Graph Databases Good to have skills : Neo4j, Python Frameworks Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: As a Data Management Practitioner, a typical day involves overseeing the stewardship of an organization's data assets to ensure they meet quality and compliance standards. This role includes designing and implementing comprehensive data strategies that uphold data integrity and enforce governance policies. The practitioner establishes and maintains protocols for managing data securely, protecting sensitive information, and optimizing the use of data across various departments. Additionally, they provide guidance on data quality standards and develop effective compliance policies to support organizational objectives and regulatory requirements. Roles & Responsibilities: - Design and implement scalable ETL and ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and load structured and unstructured data into graph databases. - Build and maintain knowledge graph infrastructure on platforms such as Neo4j, Stardog, Amazon Neptune, Stardog, or Apache Jena — including indexing, query optimization, and availability tuning. - Write and optimize complex SPARQL, Cypher, and Gremlin queries for production graph workloads including traversal, inference, and aggregation. - Implement SHACL or ShEx constraints and automated validation pipelines to enforce data conformance against ontology schemas. - Develop APIs and microservices that expose graph data to downstream consumers — including search, recommendation, and LLM/RAG pipelines. - Integrate knowledge graph layers with vector databases and embedding models to support hybrid semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation. - Collaborate with ontology designers to implement and version ontology changes safely in production without disrupting dependent services. - Monitor graph platform performance, diagnose bottlenecks, and drive reliability improvements across ingestion and query layers. - Conduct code reviews, define engineering standards, and mentor mid-level and junior developers on graph engineering best practices. - Contribute to documentation, runbooks, and internal tooling to support the broader knowledge graph team's productivity. - Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform. - Responsible for team decisions. - Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions. - Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams. - Lead initiatives to improve data governance frameworks and ensure alignment with organizational goals. - Facilitate communication and coordination between cross-functional teams to promote data compliance and quality. - Mentor junior team members to support their professional growth and enhance team capabilities. Professional & Technical Skills: - Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Graph Databases, Neo4j, Python Frameworks. - Good To Have Skills: Experience with Neo4j, Python Frameworks. - Strong knowledge of data modeling and schema design specific to graph database technologies. - Ability to develop and optimize queries for efficient data retrieval and manipulation within graph databases. - Experience in implementing data governance policies and ensuring compliance with data protection regulations. - Familiarity with integrating graph databases into broader data ecosystems and workflows. Additional Information: - The candidate should have minimum 7.5 years of experience in Graph Databases. - This position is based at our Bhubaneswar office. description: Project Role : Knowledge Engineer Project Role Description : Design and structure knowledge frameworks that enable AI systems to reason and make informed decisions. In this role you will work hands-on across the knowledge graph lifecycle from ingestion through modeling, curation, implementation, integration, and deployment. Contribute to data model designs that improve trust, interpretability, and scalability of AI-driven solutions. Support data governance initiatives including metadata management, lineage, and documentation. Ensure consistency, quality, and reusability of data assets across platforms and use cases. Enable faster solution development by providing high-quality, well-documented data foundations. Support measurable outcomes by improving data usability, consistency, and decision-making effectiveness. Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. Technical Skills Strong expertise in data modeling techniques and methodologies. Proficiency with data modeling tools (ER modeling tools, UML, or equivalent) is preferred. Experience working with relational and graph-based data models. Familiarity with semantic modeling concepts, ontologies, or knowledge graphs (e.g., RDF/OWL concepts). Ability to collaborate effectively with data engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders. Preferred Skills Exposure to knowledge graph technologies (e.g., Neo4j or similar). You Are: We are looking for a Back-End Engineer to design, build, and operate the data infrastructure and services that power our AI-driven knowledge platform. Minimum 5 years hands-on experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server), including schema design, indexing, and query optimization. Minimum 5 years experience deploying and operating vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, or Qdrant) in production environments. Minimum 5 years Proficiency in Python or Java for automation, integration, and service development and experience designing and documenting REST APIs for internal consumers. Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience Bonus Points if You Have: Familiarity with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes). Knowledge of data ingestion pipelines, ETL/integration, and enterprise system integration. Understanding of PII/PHI handling, data anonymization, and data governance. Design and build user-facing applications and dashboards that surface Knowledge Graph data to end users. Develop and maintain REST and GraphQL APIs bridging graph backends and frontend clients. Experience with graph visualization libraries (D3.js, Cytoscape.js). Familiarity with a BFF (Backend for Frontend) or API gateway pattern. Experience with AI agent-driven pipelines or RAG architectures. Understanding of Federated Knowledge Graph architectures. Experience working across Development, Test, UAT, and Production environments. Cloud platform experience (AWS Neptune, Azure Cosmos DB, or GCP). Experience with event-driven architectures and message queuing (Kafka, RabbitMQ). Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, Helm). Experience with database replication, partitioning, and high-availability patterns for relational systems. Familiarity with vector embedding pipelines and strategies for chunking, re-ranking, and retrieval optimization. title: Knowledge Engineering Consultant

description: We are: The Advanced Technology Centers (ATCs) are the engine for reinvention in our clients’ transformation journey. Powered by more than 255,000 people across 24 countries, ATCs provide our clients with seamless access to industry insights and innovative technology solutions. Stronger together! The Advanced Technology Centers (ATCs) make a tremendous impact in solving our clients’ business problems by leveraging innovation, intelligence, industry insights, new IT, and new technology skills. With the global environment changing at a faster pace, our clients are facing unprecedented challenges, and they need us more than ever before. As a Network, ATCs are positioned to unlock greater opportunities and exponential value for our clients. The value for our clients and our people: For our clients, the Network provides the strength of our geographic diversity, greater resilience, and seamless access to the deepest industry knowledge, the latest in Gen AI solutions, and tech expertise from around the world. For our people, it brings an opportunity to shape truly boundaryless career paths in a highly collaborative team of experts where they can learn from each other and solve the world’s most complex client challenges. You Are You are a Knowledge Architect at the intersection of semantic AI and agentic systems — shaping the knowledge backbone of AI platforms by designing the ontologies, graphs, and data models that enable intelligent agents to reason, plan, and act. You are equally comfortable whiteboarding an ontology with a domain expert and pushing graph schemas to production alongside an ML team. You see the world as a graph, and you believe that well-structured knowledge is the foundation of truly intelligent machines. You thrive on translating complex, messy real-world knowledge into clean, reasoned, machine-readable structures that AI agents can act on — and you bring the rigor, curiosity, and collaboration to do it at scale. The Work You will embed directly with clients as a trusted technology advisor and hands-on engineer — leading the architecture and development of knowledge graphs, ontologies, and semantic data models that power next-generation agentic AI systems at enterprise scale. Responsabilities Own the end-to-end design, governance, and maintenance of enterprise-scale knowledge graphs and ontologies, bridging structured domain knowledge with large-scale agentic AI pipelines to enable reasoning, planning, and decision-making. Develop and govern ontologies, taxonomies, and semantic data models that formalize domain knowledge and support interoperability across systems and teams. Define and enforce data modeling standards, schema design patterns, and best practices for structured and semi-structured knowledge representation. Translate complex domain knowledge from subject matter experts into formal, machine-readable knowledge structures using RDF, OWL, SPARQL, or property graph models. Lead knowledge engineering discovery workshops and working sessions with client stakeholders to surface, validate, and formalize domain knowledge requirements. Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to integrate knowledge graphs as grounding and context layers for LLM-based agentic pipelines and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems. Design knowledge structures that support multi-step agent reasoning, tool use, and dynamic planning across heterogeneous data sources. Work with project teams, team leaders, delivery leads, and client stakeholders to create standout Data & AI offerings powered by graph-based technologies. Collaborate with data engineering and platform teams to build scalable pipelines for knowledge graph population, enrichment, and lifecycle management. Develop strong client relationships and earn the trust of key stakeholders as a strategic advisor. Communicate complex ontological concepts and graph architectures clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Evaluate and pilot emerging tools, frameworks, and standards (e.g., LPG vs. RDF, Wikidata, schema.org, W3C standards). Qualified candidates in Columbus, OH; Tampa, FL; Atlanta, GA; and Houston, TX will also be considered. Travel is required and will vary between 25%–75% depending on business need and client requirements. Here´s what you need Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years' work experience). description: About the Centre for Advanced Data APAC The Centre for Advanced Data (C4AD) is Accenture's specialist centre of excellence that sets the architecture standard for modern, AI-ready data estates across APAC, and mobilises the talent to deliver them at scale. The C4AD operates across three core disciplines: Master Data Architecture, Knowledge Engineering, and Data Products. Every practitioner in the C4AD is expected to apply agentic and generative techniques as the default way of working, not as an add-on. The centre supports large-scale data and AI transformation programmes across the region, ranging from enterprise data modernisation to AI-ready platform builds. Job Description Join the Centre for Advanced Data APAC as a Knowledge Engineer, where you will own ontology and semantic strategy across engagements, set the knowledge-engineering standards for the practice, and assure the semantic layers that ground enterprise AI. You will define how the C4AD approaches knowledge representation across programmes, and hold the line on quality, consistency, and semantic integrity as those programmes scale. You will work closely with Data Architects and AI Engineers, ensuring that the ontologies and knowledge graphs you define and govern give AI systems something real, structured, and reliable to reason over. Project Description / Key Responsibilities Own ontology and semantic strategy across C4AD engagements, setting the approach, standards, and quality bar for knowledge engineering across the practice. Experience with entity resolution, semantic search, and knowledge-driven RAG architectures.
