Find clear, simple ways to show complex, constantly-changing information without overwhelming the user Translate research and data to experiences that are easy to digest and break down complexity Tailor the experience to different target audiences, covering multiple user perspectives Work cross-functionally with peers and leaders in engineering, product management, technical writing, and GTM functions, as well as other members of the Product Design team Prioritise for delivering impact while balancing business priorities, customer wishes and technical considerations Document user needs and pain points, design directions, UX trade-offs, and detailed designs for specific features and enhancements Execute research and contribute to quantitative and qualitative research initiatives with researchers, cross-functional collaborators, customers, and members of the Grafana user community What Makes You a Great Fit: 7+ years of relevant design experience working on B2B/enterprise software products, ideally designing tools and services for developers or other highly technical users A portfolio of effective designs for complex products delivered in a fast-paced environment Experience running qualitative research in complex fields, building empathy with users and humans, their needs and pain points even when you have very little in common with them Ability to make design decisions that appropriately balance business goals, product priorities, customer feedback, research insights, and technical considerations Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams across multiple locations and time-zones to iteratively ship and evolve products while keeping the end design vision in mind Attention to detail and willingness to learn about a complex, very technical product space Experience working in a fully-remote, fast-paced environment where you are expected to share openly, default to transparency, and embrace your autonomy Bonus Points For: Experience designing complex, data-dense interfaces with a focus on clarity Ability to rapidly gain an understanding of a technical domain and associated customer needs and user workflows in order to design effective experiences within that domain Domain knowledge or experience related to observability, cloud infrastructure, and/or database monitoring Experience helping design teams, especially at engineering led companies, level up their practice, collaboration with partner functions, and user and organizational impact When you apply, please: Provide an example of an experience where decision-making in a complex area is made easy through a well-curated UI. Add a sentence or two about what you believe makes it effective. Compensation & Rewards: In Germany, the Base compensation range for this role is EUR 88,240 - EUR 105,888. description: Signicatis a pan-European digital identity company that makes it easy and safe for organisations to know who they are interacting with online. Using our proprietary technology, we help companies and public organisations securely verify the identities of people and businesses, authenticate users, and enable compliant electronic document signing, so their customers can access services and complete online processes with confidence. Today, Signicat employs over 530 people across 20 offices in 15 European countries. We work with leading banks, fintechs, telcos, public authorities, healthcare providers, and enterprises across retail and mobility to deliver trusted digital identity and onboarding solutions at scale. Joining Signicat means contributing to a mission that has a real impact on how society works and trusting each other in an increasingly digital world. About the Role Imagine a software development environment where AI agents can collaborate, plan complex tasks, write code, run tests, and help engineers turn ideas into working software. That's what we're building. As a Platform Engineer in Signicat's AI Foundations team, you'll help design and build our internal AI Software Factory: a platform that enables teams of autonomous AI agents to work together, interact securely with our systems, and accelerate how we build software. This isn't just about integrating LLM APIs. We're building the foundations for agent-driven software engineering, tackling challenges around orchestration, distributed execution, state management, sandboxing, security, and human-agent collaboration. Our platform runs on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Kubernetes, with Go as our primary programming language. You'll join a team exploring the boundaries of what's possible with AI agents, combining experimentation with solid software engineering principles to turn ambitious ideas into reliable, production-ready systems. How You'll Make An Impact Build the AI Software Factory: Design and develop the core services, APIs, and infrastructure that enable AI agents to plan, execute, and collaborate on complex software engineering tasks. Orchestrate intelligent agents: Build systems that coordinate multiple specialized agents, manage dependencies, schedule work, and support long-running, asynchronous workflows. Design reliable agent runtimes: Develop secure, stateful execution environments that manage agent lifecycles, context, tool invocations, retries, recovery, and execution isolation. Make autonomous execution safe: Implement sandboxing, fine-grained permissions, and security boundaries that allow agents to interact with code, tools, and internal systems without compromising security. Connect agents to the real world: Integrate LLMs, development workflows, internal APIs, and external tools through secure, extensible interfaces and emerging standards such as MCP and A2A. Enable human-agent collaboration: Help create systems where engineers can guide, supervise, and collaborate with autonomous agents, maintaining control over important decisions. Shape the future of AI engineering: Evaluate emerging technologies, challenge existing approaches, experiment with new architectural patterns, and help define how autonomous software engineering evolves at Signicat. Solve interesting engineering problems: Apply your understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, fault tolerance, and software architecture to challenges that don't always have established solutions. Why We'll Love You You have strong software engineering experience, ideally with Go, and enjoy building robust backend services, APIs, and distributed systems. You're comfortable working with Kubernetes, containers, and cloud-native infrastructure, ideally on Google Cloud Platform. You think beyond individual services and understand how to design systems that handle concurrency, failures, asynchronous execution, and complex state transitions. You care about clean architecture, well-designed APIs, maintainable code, and automated testing. You understand the importance of security, particularly around authentication, authorization, isolation, and executing untrusted workloads. You're curious about LLMs and autonomous agents, including concepts such as tool calling, context management, multi-agent collaboration, and agent orchestration. You enjoy exploring emerging technologies, experimenting with new approaches, and turning promising ideas into practical solutions. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, taking ownership of challenging technical problems, and helping shape architectural decisions. You enjoy sharing knowledge, collaborating with others, and challenging assumptions to find better solutions. Bonus Points You've built systems using agent frameworks such as Google ADK, or worked with protocols like MCP or A2A. You have experience with sandboxing or workload isolation technologies such as gVisor, WebAssembly, or container-based execution environments. You've worked with event-driven architectures, workflow engines, distributed schedulers, or systems supporting long-running processes. You've experimented with AI coding agents, autonomous development workflows, or multi-agent systems. You have experience designing secure integrations with external services, including OAuth and delegated authorization. You've explored graph-based architectures, RDF, SPARQL, or event-driven systems, and are excited about using these concepts to model complex relationships, agent workflows, and dynamic, reactive applications. This is a wish list, not a checklist. You don't need to have worked with every technology or built AI agents before. If you're a strong engineer who loves solving complex problems and is excited about shaping the future of AI-driven software development, we'd love to hear from you. What we offer: Tailored benefits package by location - we aim to empower our employees by offering customised benefits suited to each market Your tech, your way - choose the tech gear that aligns with your comfort and meets your preferences Remote work style -while you embrace a remote environment, we support occasional in-person gatherings to strengthen the teamwork Work-life balance - enjoy an extra 5 paid days off annually, and we make sure to celebrate your work anniversaries to acknowledge the milestones you achieve Health & Wellness - we prioritise your physical and mental well-being by providing designated packs and access to the Headspace app Continuous growth - quarterly development talks, a dedicated time during working hours each week for training and development, access to Udemy courses, defined career paths, and internal mentorship opportunities Customised onboarding - we will prepare an Onboarding Plan to ensure an easy and smooth beginning Be part of an international team - the opportunity to work from any other Signicat office for 2 months per year and 3 weeks per year from any EU country Empowering feedback culture - by using employee engagement tools, we ensure that every voice is heard, empowering us to grow together Meet-ups - frequent office gatherings and biennial Kick-off event to bring every Signicat under one roof that you don’t want to miss Salary: €70,000-€90,000 gross yearly. We are open to discussing the salary based on your skills and competencies. Originally posted on Himalayas

In this role, you will work closely with our Marketing, Sales, and Data Engineering teams to build the foundational "Gold Layers" and semantic models that enable self-serve reporting and agentic AI workflows. description: About the Job: LaunchDarkly is seeking a Sr. Director, Enablement to join our Revenue team. This position will report to the VP, Revenue Operations and Enablement. description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X. We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. Senior Product Designer, Knowledge Graph This is a remote position based in Ireland. The Opportunity: As a Senior Product Designer at Grafana Labs, you will join a growing Product Design organization of more than 25 designers, researchers, engineers, and design leaders distributed across six continents. You will work within a 100% remote R&D organization, so strong, proactive remote communication, collaboration, facilitation, and relationship building skills will be essential to your success. As Senior Product Designer for Grafana Cloud’s Knowledge Graph, you'll design experiences for the context layer of Grafana Cloud that powers our entity graph, entity catalog and RCA workbench. Knowledge Graph automatically discovers services, infrastructure, and databases from the telemetry teams already have, maps how they depend on each other, and runs anomaly detection. This gives engineers, SREs, and their agents an up to date picture of their systems. We want anyone to be able to understand a system and resolve an incident faster, without writing queries or maintaining alert rules, not just the one person who happens to know it best. Over time, you will develop deep expertise in your product area and associated customer and user personas, use cases, and workflows, which will enable you to design tailored, role-driven experiences. You will also have an opportunity to contribute to the evolution of the Product Design team at Grafana by coaching and mentoring other designers, collaborating on team internal initiatives, and helping evolve new ways of working, learning, and having fun together as the team scales. What You’ll Be Doing: Enabling customers to easily understand and explore how their systems connect to each other. Find clear, simple ways to show complex, constantly-changing information without overwhelming the user Translate research and data to experiences that are easy to digest and break down complexity Tailor the experience to different target audiences, covering multiple user perspectives Work cross-functionally with peers and leaders in engineering, product management, technical writing, and GTM functions, as well as other members of the Product Design team Prioritise for delivering impact while balancing business priorities, customer wishes and technical considerations Document user needs and pain points, design directions, UX trade-offs, and detailed designs for specific features and enhancements Execute research and contribute to quantitative and qualitative research initiatives with researchers, cross-functional collaborators, customers, and members of the Grafana user community What Makes You a Great Fit: 7+ years of relevant design experience working on B2B/enterprise software products, ideally designing tools and services for developers or other highly technical users A portfolio of effective designs for complex products delivered in a fast-paced environment Experience running qualitative research in complex fields, building empathy with users and humans, their needs and pain points even when you have very little in common with them Ability to make design decisions that appropriately balance business goals, product priorities, customer feedback, research insights, and technical considerations Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams across multiple locations and time-zones to iteratively ship and evolve products while keeping the end design vision in mind Attention to detail and willingness to learn about a complex, very technical product space Experience working in a fully-remote, fast-paced environment where you are expected to share openly, default to transparency, and embrace your autonomy Bonus Points For: Experience designing complex, data-dense interfaces with a focus on clarity Ability to rapidly gain an understanding of a technical domain and associated customer needs and user workflows in order to design effective experiences within that domain Domain knowledge or experience related to observability, cloud infrastructure, and/or database monitoring Experience helping design teams, especially at engineering led companies, level up their practice, collaboration with partner functions, and user and organizational impact When you apply, please: Provide an example of an experience where decision-making in a complex area is made easy through a well-curated UI. Add a sentence or two about what you believe makes it effective. Compensation & Rewards: In Ireland, the Base compensation range for this role is EUR 94,760 - EUR 113,712. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. description: Role Description We are seeking a CMMC Compliance Lead to join Commercial Cyber Operations. This person is the customer-facing lead for CMMC Level 1 and Level 2 engagements and owns NIST SP 800-171 interpretation, scoping, documentation, and assessment readiness from kickoff through the C3PAO assessment and into sustainment. Compliance Lead decides what the systems must satisfy, can configure the controls personally in Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 GCC High, writes the record that proves it, and verifies the result the way an assessor would. This is not a coordination role. The Compliance Lead scopes the assessment boundary, authors the System Security Plan and supporting documentation, directs and where needed performs control implementation, assesses the finished environment against the CMMC Level 2 Assessment Guide, and stands next to the customer during the assessment. They are the day-to-day point of contact for their assigned customers and answer CMMC questions with authority and in plain terms. Customer environments vary: Windows and macOS fleets, GCC High and Google Workspace tenants, Jamf and Intune, cloud and on-prem enclaves. This person has to be versatile enough to work in all of them. Responsibilities The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is able to adapt and take on new responsibilities as they arise. Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers for the life of the engagement: run kickoff, working sessions, and status reporting; answer CMMC and NIST SP 800-171 questions directly and accurately without escalation. Scope the CMMC assessment boundary: trace FCI and CUI flows, categorize assets per the CMMC Level 2 Scoping Guide (CUI, Security Protection, Contractor Risk Managed, Specialized, Out of Scope), and produce the boundary, data-flow, and network diagrams. Lead each engagement through the standard delivery process from intake to assessor-ready package, holding the stage gates and evidence standards. Author and maintain the System Security Plan, policies and procedures, POA&M, and evidence library at the assessment-objective level; score self-assessments and SPRS submissions under the DoD Assessment Methodology and 32 CFR Part 170. Implement the technical controls hands-on in the customer tenant: identity, MFA, and conditional access in Entra ID or Google Cloud Identity; least privilege and privileged-account separation; data protection in Microsoft Purview or Google Workspace DLP; FIPS-validated encryption; configuration baselines. Decide which requirement each setting satisfies and why, and split the heavier build work with the Technical Implementation Engineer. Stand up and operate endpoint management across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android with Microsoft Intune and Jamf (Apple Business Manager, Android Enterprise): enrollment, compliance policies, CIS or DISA STIG baselines, BitLocker and FileVault, patching, and removable-media control. Build the logging and monitoring stack the AU, RA, and SI practices require: centralized audit logging and alerting in a SIEM (Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps, Splunk, or similar), log retention and review cadence, vulnerability scanning and remediation tracking, and backup and recovery verification. Assess the finished environment against the CMMC Level 2 Assessment Guide using examine, interview, and test methods; run the pre-assessment readiness review and close gaps before the C3PAO arrives. Prepare customers for C3PAO assessments and support them during assessment week: evidence presentation, interview coaching, assessor questions, and post-assessment POA&M closeout. Run sustainment for customers: continuous monitoring cadence, change reviews, annual affirmations, and reassessment readiness. Improve the practice: turn repeatable work into templates, checklists, and automation, and contribute domain content to the team's internal AI tooling. Minimum Experience and Qualifications Experience taking defense contractors through NIST SP 800-171 / CMMC Level 2 end to end, from scoping through assessment, including at least one organization you personally led through a successful C3PAO or DIBCAC assessment as the consultant, assessor, or internal compliance lead. Proven ability to write assessor-ready documentation: System Security Plans at the assessment-objective level, policies and procedures, POA&Ms, and data-flow and network diagrams. Hands-on experience implementing NIST SP 800-171 technical controls yourself in Microsoft 365 GCC High (Entra ID, Intune, Purview, Defender) or Google Workspace (Admin console, Cloud Identity, context-aware access, endpoint management): the admin-console work, not only the policy; able to validate what an implementation engineer built rather than accept a screenshot. Endpoint management experience across Windows and macOS (iOS and Android a plus) with at least one of Microsoft Intune or Jamf: enrollment, compliance and configuration policies, disk encryption, patching, and hardening baselines. Experience centralizing audit logs and alerts in a SIEM or log platform (Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps, Splunk, or similar) and operating vulnerability scanning, patch management, and backup to satisfy the AU, RA, SI, and MP practices. Working knowledge of networking and perimeter controls (firewalls, VPN and secure remote access, segmentation, DNS, wireless), enough to scope the boundary and verify the SC practices. Customer-facing lead: runs meetings, explains requirements in plain terms to executives and IT staff, documents decisions, pushes back constructively, and delivers without close supervision. Ability to run multiple concurrent engagements (typically 4–6), track milestones, and report status in a remote, asynchronous environment (Slack, Notion, Google Workspace). Preferred Experience and Qualifications CMMC Certified Assessor (CCA) strongly preferred; CMMC Certified Professional (CCP) at minimum. Lead CCA designation or Registered Practitioner Advanced (RPA) a plus. Hands-on implementation experience in both Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 GCC High, including GCC High migrations and Google Workspace configurations built to NIST SP 800-171. Depth in Apple Business Manager, Android Enterprise, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Sentinel, or Google SecOps; CIS Benchmarks or DISA STIG hardening; Windows Server and Active Directory in hybrid environments. CUI enclave design and migration: GCC High, Azure Government, AWS GovCloud, or on-prem enclaves, including FedRAMP Moderate equivalency evaluation of cloud service providers and scoping of external service providers. Travel Expectations/Requirements: 10%–25% (customer kickoffs, on-site readiness reviews, C3PAO assessment weeks) Full compensation packages are based on candidate experience. description: EMPLOYER IS A CONTRACTOR FOR THE U.S. GOVERNMENT. THIS POSITION REQUIRES U.S. CITIZENSHIP. Role Description This is a forward-deployed engineering role. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with mission heroes- the users, operators, and program engineers who run real workloads in real DoD environments- and lead the software integration of modular Counter-Unmanned Aerial Systems (C-UAS) sensors and effectors. You will deploy, harden, integrate, and operate our modular C-UAS solution. Forward-deployed means aligned with the mission hero, not always on a plane. Most of the work is remote. You'll travel to sites when the engagement genuinely calls for it — initial standup, in-SCIF integration work, on-the-ground incident response, training, and knowledge transfer- and you'll be on a video call or in a shared chat with that same mission hero the rest of the time. The job is being their engineer, not living at their desk. You are a cross-functional engineering leader. You can take responsibility for the full breadth of a data and software integration platform- make it work where it has to work, analyze what's running through it, and solve problems in real time for the mission hero. About 20% of your time, you'll also help make Defense Unicorns' forward-deployed team better — pairing with junior Data Engineer FDEs on hard problems, helping them develop technical judgment, and raising the ceiling on what the team can take on. Responsibilities Deploy and harden UDS Data Capability in the mission hero's environment — stand up UDS Store (Iceberg, Rook/Ceph, pgvector, Postgres), wire up UDS Transit for air-gap data movement, configure UDS Govern policies (Pepr/Lula), and integrate UDS Connect (Strimzi/Kafka) where streaming or legacy connectors are required. Own integration with existing mission systems — connect UDS Data Capability to existing infrastructure, including sensor arrays, computer-vision-enabled UAS interceptors, and a broad range of C-UAS solutions. Build pipelines that move data through classification boundaries — ingestion, transformation, catalog registration, model/dataset packaging via Zarf, cross-domain transit, and eventual consistency across DDIL conditions. Operate what you deploy — own initial day-2 operations, including capacity, performance, backup/restore (Velero), observability (Vector/Loki), incident response, and upgrade paths. Transition ownership to the mission hero's operations team once stable. Generate accreditation artifacts — STIG evidence, cATO documentation, FIPS validation notes, and policy mappings to support ISSM/ISSO requirements in IL4/IL5 environments. Represent the mission hero to product and engineering — document issues, write postmortems, recommend operator improvements, and communicate field challenges to the platform engineering team. Train and transfer knowledge — develop runbooks, architecture documentation, working sessions, and knowledge-transfer materials that enable mission teams to operate independently. Mentor junior Data Engineer FDEs — pair on complex problems, review integration designs, and help engineers develop technical judgment without direct people-management responsibilities. Clearance & Travel Clearance: Active TS/SCI required. Travel: Approximately 10%–25%, based on mission and customer requirements. Title: Sr. Principal Sales Training Manager Location: United States (Remote) Experience: Senior Job Function: Business Transformation Employment Type: Full-time Industry: Computer & Network Security About the position The Senior Principal Sales Training Manager drives hands-on training, execution, and adoption of Keyfactor's global sales enablement programs. This role works directly with sellers and sales leaders to ensure the skills, methodologies, messaging, and tools introduced through enablement are consistently applied in the field. A significant portion of this role focuses on delivering consistent, high-impact onboarding experience, guiding new sellers from initial training and certification through field readiness and productivity. This role also supports ongoing everboarding through live customer call observation, Gong reviews, and targeted coaching to reinforce skills and drive consistent field execution. The Senior Principal Sales Training Manager plays a critical role in reinforcing Keyfactor’s Value Selling and MEDDICC methodologies, helping sellers improve discovery, qualification, business value conversations, multi-threading, executive engagement, and overall opportunity execution. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Job Responsibilities Onboarding & Ramp Support Execute established onboarding programs for new sales hires and ensure consistent delivery across cohorts. Facilitate live training, workshops, role-playing, certifications, and practice sessions. Track new-hire progress against established onboarding and ramp milestones. Observe new hires in live selling situations and through Gong to evaluate field readiness and identify coaching needs. Provide targeted reinforcement to help new sellers close knowledge or skill gaps and accelerate their path to productivity. Communicate progress, risks, and coaching needs to Enablement and Sales Leadership. Value Selling & MEDDICC Execution Reinforce consistent application of Value Selling and MEDDICC throughout the sales cycle, including discovery, qualification, multi-threading, champion development, and executive engagement. Coach sellers to connect technical challenges to business initiatives, desired outcomes, measurable impact, and executive priorities, strengthening why change, why now, and cost-of-status-quo conversations. Evaluate seller execution of MEDDICC within active opportunities and provide targeted coaching to strengthen business cases, customer conversations, and deal execution. Reinforce Keyfactor’s established messaging, sales plays, competitive positioning, and value propositions, helping sellers communicate effectively with both technical and executive audiences. Identify recurring gaps in sales skills, methodology, messaging, and technical-to-business translation and share insights with Enablement and Sales Leadership to drive targeted reinforcement. Field Coaching & Insights Observe seller execution through live customer calls, Gong recordings, and field engagement, providing timely, actionable coaching to individuals and teams. Track seller competency and adoption of enablement programs, messaging, and sales methodologies using Gong, CRM data, enablement platforms, and direct observation. Reinforce skills introduced through onboarding and ongoing enablement through continuous coaching, practice, feedback, and field application. Identify recurring skill gaps, coaching needs, and field trends, providing actionable insights to Enablement, Sales Leadership, and frontline managers. Surface and share best practices and examples of strong execution, while measuring how enablement and coaching translate into improved seller performance. Minimum Qualifications, Education, and Skills Experience: 8+ years of experience in B2B enterprise software, cybersecurity, sales, or sales enablement, with significant experience coaching enterprise sellers. Field Coaching: Demonstrated ability to observe live sales interactions, diagnose skill gaps, and provide specific, actionable coaching. Methodology Expertise: Strong working knowledge of Value Selling and MEDDICC, with experience reinforcing methodology in active enterprise opportunities. Enterprise Sales Expertise: Strong understanding of complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles and the behaviors required to successfully navigate them. Technical-to-Business Fluency: Ability to understand complex technical concepts and coach sellers on translating them into clear customer outcomes and business value. Facilitation: Strong facilitator comfortable leading onboarding sessions, workshops, role-playing exercises, certifications, and reinforcement sessions. Analytical Mindset: Ability to use Gong, CRM, enablement data, and direct observation to identify trends and measure seller progress. Coaching & Communication: Ability to build credibility with experienced sellers and sales leaders while delivering candid, actionable feedback. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to work closely with Sales Leadership, Sales Engineering, Product Marketing, Product, Revenue Operations, and the broader Enablement team. Technology Fluency: Experience working with CRM, conversation intelligence, LMS/enablement platforms, and AI-powered sales tools. Travel Requirements Up to 40% travel required. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas. Wellbeing resources, wellness allowance, mindfulness app free membership, Wellness Wednesdays. Global Volunteer Day, company non-profit matching, and 3 volunteer days off. We thrive in high-paced and continually changing environments. We navigate through newly added variables, adjust accordingly, while driving towards our strategic goals. United by respect.
